TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encodeList_injective_of_fixedWidth {α : Type} {f : α → List Bool} (hf : Function.Injective f) (width : ℕ) (hwidth : ∀ a, (f a).length = width) : Function.Injective (BoolCircuit.encodeList f)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Constant-width injective element codes give an injective tagged-list code: `Injective f` and `length (f a) = width` imply `Injective (encodeList f)`. Encoding glue; no positivity or inhabitedness assumption is needed. The private generic prefix-free-list result in `BoolCircuit` is not accessed.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encodeList_length_of_fixedWidth {α : Type} (f : α → List Bool) (width : ℕ) (hwidth : ∀ a, (f a).length = width) (xs : List α) : (BoolCircuit.encodeList f xs).length = xs.length * (width + 1) + 1
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Equal-width element codes have exact tagged-list length: `length (encodeList f xs) = length xs * (width + 1) + 1`. Encoding glue; the formula includes all true tags and the final false marker, including the empty list and width zero. It is an equality for constant blocks, rather than a restatement of the private variable-block-size upper bound.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure BoolPRG
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A Boolean generator has an exactly uniform Boolean seed and a sampled function index, with uniformly efficient index sampling and evaluation. [JLS26, Definition 3.4, p. 11]. Deviations Dv4 and Dv17: the family is indexed by seed length, and index sampling is a core applied to one exact finite draw; efficiency uses the shared sampler contract. Disclosed pre-M0 refinement: supplied finite-coordinate equivalences and injective encodings retain the complete index and draw instead of hiding data in encoding collisions.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: instance instBoolPRGIdxFintype (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) : Fintype (G.Idx n)
instance instBoolPRGIdDrawFintype (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) : Fintype (G.IdDraw n)
theorem instBoolPRGIdxFintype_eq (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) : instBoolPRGIdxFintype G n = G.idxFintype n
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean index finiteness instance is its supplied primitive field; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem instBoolPRGIdDrawFintype_eq (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) : instBoolPRGIdDrawFintype G n = G.idDrawFintype n
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean index-draw finiteness instance is its supplied primitive field; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def idSamp (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) : ProbComp (G.Idx n)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index sampler is the core applied to one uniform draw: `idSamp n = sample (IdDraw n) >>= fun d => pure (idCore n d)`. [JLS26, Definition 3.4, p. 11]. Deviation Dv17: the exact-law core-and-draw interface makes the efficiency field refer to this actual law.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idSamp_eq (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) : G.idSamp n = (ProbComp.sample (G.IdDraw n)).bind fun d => .pure (G.idCore n d)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index law is the pushforward of its uniform draw by `idCore`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def EvalEfficient (G : BoolPRG) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Uniform evaluation efficiency is one map computing all indexed evaluations: `∃ f, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ n I σ, f ⟨1^n,⟨I,σ⟩⟩ = Eval(I,σ)`. [JLS26, Definition 3.4, p. 11]. The unary parameter is explicit; no advice is supplied.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem evalEfficient_iff (G : BoolPRG) : G.EvalEfficient ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ n I σ, f (NUPPT.advInput n (pairEncode (G.encIdx n I) (List.ofFn σ))) = List.ofFn (G.eval n I σ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Evaluation efficiency is exactly the single-map input/output contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem evalEfficient (G : BoolPRG) : G.EvalEfficient
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every Boolean primitive carries its evaluation-efficiency witness; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def challengeStr (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) (I : G.Idx n) (z : Fin (G.outLen n) → Bool) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The challenge is `⟨encIdx I, List.ofFn z⟩` for an index and Boolean output vector. [JLS26, Definitions 3.2 and 3.4, pp. 10-11]. The Boolean assumption has no field modulus; its canonical challenge therefore contains only the index and output.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem challengeStr_eq (G : BoolPRG) (n : ℕ) (I : G.Idx n) (z : Fin (G.outLen n) → Bool) : G.challengeStr n I z = pairEncode (G.encIdx n I) (List.ofFn z)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean challenge is the pair of encoded index and output; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def game (G : BoolPRG) (A : NUPPT) (real : Bool) (n : ℕ) : ProbComp Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The real/random game gives the adversary a sampled index and either the generator output on a uniform seed or an independent uniform output. [JLS26, Definitions 3.2 and 3.4, pp. 10-11]. Deviation Dv4: the security parameter is the Boolean seed length `n`.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem game_eq (G : BoolPRG) (A : NUPPT) (real : Bool) (n : ℕ) : G.game A real n = (G.idSamp n).bind fun I => (ProbComp.sample (Fin n → Bool)).bind fun σ => (ProbComp.sample (Fin (G.outLen n) → Bool)).bind fun u => (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins n)).bind fun r => .pure (A.distinguisherL n (G.challengeStr n I (if real then G.eval n I σ else u)) r)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The game samples the actual index law, seed, comparison output, and adversary coins; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def adv (G : BoolPRG) (A : NUPPT) (n : ℕ) : ℝ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean PRG advantage is the absolute real/random acceptance gap. [JLS26, Definitions 2.1 and 3.4, pp. 8-11]. Deviation Dv4: absolute advantage against non-uniform PPT machines is the library convention.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem adv_eq (G : BoolPRG) (A : NUPPT) (n : ℕ) : G.adv A n = Games.advantage (G.game A true n) (G.game A false n)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advantage is `Games.advantage` of the two games; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def Secure (G : BoolPRG) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Boolean PRG security means negligible advantage for every non-uniform PPT machine: `Secure G ↔ ∀ A, Negligible (G.adv A)`. [JLS26, Definitions 2.1 and 3.4, pp. 8-11].

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem secure_iff (G : BoolPRG) : G.Secure ↔ ∀ A : NUPPT, Negligible (G.adv A)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Security is negligible advantage for every non-uniform PPT machine; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def SubexpSecure (G : BoolPRG) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Subexponential Boolean security is exactly `SubexpHard G.adv`. [JLS26, Remark 2.1 and Theorem 4.1, pp. 9 and 11]. Deviation Dv13: adversaries remain NUPPT machines, using the shared advantage notion.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem subexpSecure_iff (G : BoolPRG) : G.SubexpSecure ↔ SubexpHard G.adv
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Subexponential Boolean security uses the shared `SubexpHard` predicate; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasStretch (G : BoolPRG) (τ : ℝ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Stretch at least `τ` means `n^τ ≤ outLen n` at every seed length. [JLS26, Definition 3.4 and Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Deviation Dv5: an inequality replaces `m = n^τ`, avoiding truncation of the supplied generator.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasStretch_iff (G : BoolPRG) (τ : ℝ) : G.HasStretch τ ↔ ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ^ τ ≤ G.outLen n
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Stretch is the pointwise lower bound `n^τ ≤ outLen n`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure MultilinearRep (G : BoolPRG) (d : ℕ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A degree-`d` multilinear representation supplies integer polynomials whose Boolean-cube values equal the output bits. [JLS26, Definition 3.4, p. 11]. Deviation Dv4: the representation is data for every index, and locality is measured on its variables; semantic uniqueness is not an additional theorem of this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasLocality {G : BoolPRG} {d : ℕ} (R : G.MultilinearRep d) (cLoc : ℕ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Locality at most `cLoc` means every output polynomial uses at most `cLoc` variables. [JLS26, Definition 3.4, p. 11]. Deviation Dv4: locality is read on the supplied multilinear representation, for every index rather than only those in the sampling support.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasLocality_iff {G : BoolPRG} {d : ℕ} (R : G.MultilinearRep d) (cLoc : ℕ) : R.HasLocality cLoc ↔ ∀ n I j, (R.poly n I j).vars.card ≤ cLoc
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Locality is the variable-cardinality bound for every output coordinate; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def TermsEfficient {G : BoolPRG} {d : ℕ} (R : G.MultilinearRep d) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Efficient representation generation uses one polynomial-time map to output an explicit term list for every polynomial. [JLS26, Section 2, p. 8]. Deviation Dv14: signed integer coefficients and finite variable coordinates use the explicit `PolyTerms` code. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem termsEfficient_iff {G : BoolPRG} {d : ℕ} (R : G.MultilinearRep d) : R.TermsEfficient ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ n I j, ∃ ts : PolyTerms (Fin n) ℤ, f (NUPPT.advInput n (pairEncode (G.encIdx n I) (PolyTerms.encFin j))) = PolyTerms.encTerms PolyTerms.encInt PolyTerms.encFin ts ∧ PolyTerms.denote ts = R.poly n I j
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Efficient representation generation is exactly the uniform term-list contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def bucket (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (b : Fin B) : Finset (Fin m)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A bucket is the finite fiber `bucket φ b = {j | φ j = b}` [JLS26, construction of IdSamp', p. 15]. Indices start at zero.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucket_eq (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (b : Fin B) : bucket φ b = Finset.univ.filter (fun j => φ j = b)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A bucket equals the finite fiber of its label. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def load (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (b : Fin B) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A bucket's load is its cardinality, `load φ b = (bucket φ b).card` [JLS26, construction of IdSamp', p. 15].

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem load_eq (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (b : Fin B) : load φ b = (bucket φ b).card
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A bucket's load equals its cardinality. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def overfull (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (cap : ℕ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A placement is overfull if some load exceeds capacity, `overfull φ cap ↔ ∃ b, cap < load φ b` [JLS26, construction of IdSamp', p. 15].

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem overfull_iff (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (cap : ℕ) : overfull φ cap ↔ ∃ b, cap < load φ b
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A placement is overfull exactly when some bucket exceeds capacity. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def rank (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (j : Fin m) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: An output's bucket rank counts earlier outputs with the same label, `rank φ j = #{i | i < j ∧ φ i = φ j}` [JLS26, construction of IdSamp', p. 15]. Increasing ranks make the paper's permitted injection deterministic.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem rank_eq (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (j : Fin m) : rank φ j = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => i < j ∧ φ i = φ j)).card
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The bucket rank counts preceding elements in the same fiber. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def indexMap (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (j : Fin m) : Option (Fin rc × Fin rc)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Grid positions split increasing bucket ranks using `finProdFinEquiv.symm` [JLS26, construction of IdSamp', p. 15]. The overfull case returns `none`, including empty grids, instead of the paper's constant point; no successful case is changed.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem indexMap_eq (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (j : Fin m) : indexMap φ rc j = if h : ¬ (∃ b : Fin B, rc * rc < load φ b) ∧ rank φ j < rc * rc then some (finProdFinEquiv.symm ⟨rank φ j, h.2⟩) else none
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Grid positions are optional split ranks, with `none` on overfull placements. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem rank_lt_load (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (j : Fin m) : rank φ j < load φ (φ j)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Each element's rank is strictly below its bucket's load [JLS26, construction, p. 15]. This is mathematical glue for the deterministic placement.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem eq_of_rank_eq (φ : Fin m → Fin B) {i j : Fin m} (hφ : φ i = φ j) (hr : rank φ i = rank φ j) : i = j
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Equal ranks in the same bucket identify an output [JLS26, construction, p. 15]. This is mathematical glue for the deterministic placement.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem indexMap_some_of_not_overfull (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (h : ¬ overfull φ (rc * rc)) (j : Fin m) : ∃ c : Fin rc × Fin rc, indexMap φ rc j = some c
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Non-overfull placements assign a grid point to every output [JLS26, construction, p. 15]. The optional representation changes no good-case position.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem indexMap_none_of_overfull (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (h : overfull φ (rc * rc)) (j : Fin m) : indexMap φ rc j = none
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Overfull placements have no grid positions [JLS26, construction, p. 15]. This replaces the paper's unused overfull default by `none` to allow empty grids.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem indexMap_injective_on_bucket (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (h : ¬ overfull φ (rc * rc)) {i j : Fin m} (hφ : φ i = φ j) (hc : indexMap φ rc i = indexMap φ rc j) : i = j
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Non-overfull bucket positions are injective within each bucket [JLS26, construction of IdSamp', p. 15]. Increasing ranks fix the permitted injection.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def bucketMatrix (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (corr : Fin m → R) (b : Fin B) : Matrix (Fin rc) (Fin rc) R
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A bucket correction matrix sums corrections at matching grid positions, `M_b(u,v) = ∑ j, [φ j = b ∧ indexMap j = some (u,v)] corr j` [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Increasing ranks fix the paper's positions; `none` contributes nothing, so the empty-grid boundary is total.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucketMatrix_eq (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (corr : Fin m → R) (b : Fin B) : bucketMatrix φ rc corr b = fun u v => ∑ j : Fin m, if φ j = b ∧ indexMap φ rc j = some (u, v) then corr j else 0
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Bucket matrix entries equal the finite sum of corrections assigned to them. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucketMatrix_apply_indexMap (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (corr : Fin m → R) (h : ¬ overfull φ (rc * rc)) (j : Fin m) (c : Fin rc × Fin rc) (hc : indexMap φ rc j = some c) : bucketMatrix φ rc corr (φ j) c.1 c.2 = corr j
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A non-overfull bucket matrix contains each correction at its assigned position [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. The deterministic positions are injective.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucketMatrix_nonzero_card_le [DecidableEq R] (φ : Fin m → Fin B) (rc : ℕ) (corr : Fin m → R) (bad : Finset (Fin m)) (hcorr : ∀ j, j ∉ bad → corr j = 0) (b : Fin B) : (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : Fin rc × Fin rc => bucketMatrix φ rc corr b c.1 c.2 ≠ 0)).card ≤ (bucket φ b ∩ bad).card
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A correction matrix has at most as many nonzero entries as supported outputs in its bucket [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. The finite cardinal bound avoids rank theory.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem claim42 (P : Params) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) : ∃ κ₀, ∀ κ ≥ κ₀, ∀ pp : PrimeParam κ, P.errProb κ pp ≤ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For all sufficiently large κ the error event has probability at most 2^(-κ), uniformly in every public prime [JLS26, Claim 4.2, pp. 19-21]. Dv3 uses the rounded rational noise schedule (SP-W1); Dv7 makes the common eventual threshold explicit.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucket_count_upper (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.B κ ≤ P.m κ * κ + 1
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The rounded bucket count satisfies `B κ ≤ m κ * κ + 1`; glue for the JLS allocation. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucket_count_lower (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.m κ * κ ≤ P.B κ * P.W κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The rounded bucket count covers the allocation: `m κ * κ ≤ B κ * W κ`; glue. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prefactor_eventually_le_two_pow (P : Params) : ∃ κ₀, ∀ κ ≥ κ₀, (((κ + 1) * P.B κ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The construction prefactor `(κ+1)*B κ+1` is eventually at most `2^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem binomial_ratio_quarter (N B r κ : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (hr : 0 < r) (hbase : 4 * Real.exp 1 * (N : ℝ) ≤ (B : ℝ) * r) (hκ : κ ≤ r) : (Nat.choose N r : ℝ) / (B : ℝ) ^ r ≤ (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For positive B,r with `4*exp(1)*N ≤ B*r` and `κ ≤ r`, the ratio `choose(N,r)/B^r` is at most `4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem smallset_bucket_tail_quarter (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (S : Finset (Fin (P.m κ))) (hκ : 12 ≤ κ) (hS : S.card ≤ P.Γ κ) (hΓ : P.Γ κ ≤ P.B κ) : uprob (fun φ : Fin (P.m κ) → Fin (P.B κ) => ∃ b, κ < (Buckets.bucket φ b ∩ S).card) ≤ (P.B κ : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For κ≥12 and Γ κ≤B κ, every fixed set of size at most Γ κ has some overloaded bucket with probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem- only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem capacity_bucket_tail_quarter (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (hκ : 12 ≤ κ) : uprob (fun φ : Fin (P.m κ) → Fin (P.B κ) => ∃ b, P.cap κ < Buckets.load φ b) ≤ (P.B κ : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For κ≥12, uniform placement exceeds the rounded capacity in some bucket with probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond1_single_le_quarter (P : Params) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (hlog : 4 * cLoc ≤ Nat.log 2 (P.n κ)) : Games.ProbComp.prob (Games.ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p)) (fun r => P.Γ κ < (P.badSet κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp (r i))).card) ≤ (4 : ℝ)⁻¹
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: If `4*cLoc ≤ log₂(n κ)`, one fixed-index bad-count failure has probability at most 1/4. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond1_repetitions_fixed_index (P : Params) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (hlog : 4 * cLoc ≤ Nat.log 2 (P.n κ)) : uprob (fun reps : Fin κ → (Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) × (Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) => ∀ k, P.Γ κ < (P.badSet κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp ((reps k).2 i))).card) ≤ (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: At a fixed complete index, the probability that every independent repetition satisfies Cond1 is at most `4⁻¹^κ`, under the logarithmic locality bound. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond1_all_fixed_index (P : Params) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (hlog : 4 * cLoc ≤ Nat.log 2 (P.n κ)) : Games.ProbComp.prob (P.sdSampFull κ pp I) (fun x => ∀ k, P.Cond1 κ pp I x.draw k) ≤ (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Under the logarithmic locality bound, the full seed-core law at each fixed index has simultaneous Cond1 probability at most `4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond1_all_joint (P : Params) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (hlog : 4 * cLoc ≤ Nat.log 2 (P.n κ)) : Games.ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => ∀ k, P.Cond1 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k) ≤ (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Under the logarithmic locality bound, simultaneous Cond1 under the actual joint law has probability at most `4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond3_joint_le_quarter_pow (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (hκ : 12 ≤ κ) : Games.ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => P.Cond3 κ pp x.1) ≤ (P.B κ : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For κ≥12, common capacity failure under the actual joint law has probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond2_sparse_joint_le_quarter_pow (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (k : Fin κ) (hκ : 12 ≤ κ) (hΓ : P.Γ κ ≤ P.B κ) : Games.ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => P.Cond2 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k ∧ ¬ P.Cond1 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k) ≤ (P.B κ : ℝ) * (4 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For κ≥12 and Γ κ≤B κ, each joint Cond2-and-not-Cond1 event has probability at most `B κ * 4⁻¹^κ`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 20-21]. This is theorem-only analytic glue; no sampling or efficiency construction is introduced.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem errProb_le_decomposition (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.errProb κ pp ≤ ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => P.Cond3 κ pp x.1) + (∑ k : Fin κ, ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => P.Cond2 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k ∧ ¬ P.Cond1 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k)) + ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) (fun x => ∀ k, P.Cond1 κ pp x.1 x.2.draw k)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The error event is bounded by common capacity failure, the sparse-but-overloaded repetitions, and simultaneous bad-count failure [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 21]. Dv7 keeps every probability explicit before taking eventual estimates.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def Cond1 (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) (k : Fin κ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The first failure condition is too many bad outputs in repetition k [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 19-20]. Dv3 uses the rounded threshold Γ.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond1_iff (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) (k : Fin κ) : P.Cond1 κ pp I d k ↔ P.Γ κ < (P.badSet κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp ((d.2 k).2 i))).card
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The first condition compares the bad-output count with Γ; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def Cond2 (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) (k : Fin κ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The second failure condition is more than t bad outputs in some bucket [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 19-20]. Dv3 uses an integer threshold.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond2_iff (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) (k : Fin κ) : P.Cond2 κ pp I d k ↔ ∃ b : Fin (P.B κ), P.t κ < (Buckets.bucket I.2.1 b ∩ P.badSet κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp ((d.2 k).2 i))).card
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The second condition is the finite bucket-overload event for bad outputs; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def Cond3 (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The third failure condition is a bucket beyond capacity [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 19-20]. This event is shared by all repetitions.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond3_iff (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : P.Cond3 κ pp I ↔ Buckets.overfull I.2.1 (P.cap κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The third condition is the overfull-placement predicate; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def jointLaw (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : ProbComp (P.Idx' κ pp × P.SdCoreOut κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The proof-facing joint law retains index and full seed-core output [JLS26, Claim 4.2, p. 19]. Dv17 uses exact finite draws, without a coin sampler.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jointLaw_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.jointLaw κ pp = (P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I => (fun x => (I, x)) <$> P.sdSampFull κ pp I
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The joint law samples index and the corresponding core output; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jointLaw_prob_eq_uprob (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (event : (P.Idx' κ pp × P.SdCoreOut κ pp) → Prop) : Games.ProbComp.prob (P.jointLaw κ pp) event = uprob (fun z : P.IdDraw κ pp × P.Draw κ pp => event (P.idCore κ pp z.1, P.sdCore κ pp (P.idCore κ pp z.1) z.2))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The probability of any event under jointLaw equals its probability after the index and seed cores are applied to one uniform raw product draw. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, pp. 19-21]; semantic probability reader glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def errProb (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : ℝ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Error probability is the exact chance that SdSamp' finds no successful repetition [JLS26, Claim 4.2, p. 19]. Dv7 leaves its value explicit at every κ and pp.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem errProb_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.errProb κ pp = ProbComp.prob ((P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I => P.sdSampFull κ pp I) (fun x => x.err = true)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Error probability is the stated exact-law event; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem errProb_nonneg (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : 0 ≤ P.errProb κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Error probabilities are nonnegative; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem badSet_expect_le (P : Params) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p)) (fun r => ((P.badSet κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp (r i))).card : ℝ)) ≤ (cLoc : ℝ) * P.m κ / P.W κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Locality bounds the expected number of bad output coordinates by cLoc*m/W [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 20]. Dv3 uses exact rounded noise, and the bound is uniform in every public prime and index.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem cond1_prob_le (P : Params) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : ProbComp.prob (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p)) (fun r => P.Γ κ < (P.badSet κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp (r i))).card) ≤ (cLoc : ℝ) * P.m κ / ((P.W κ : ℝ) * (P.Γ κ + 1))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Markov's inequality bounds the too-many-bad event using Γ+1 [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 20]. Dv3 makes the strict integer threshold explicit, avoiding any division by Γ=0.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem binomial_bound (n k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : (Nat.choose n k : ℝ) ≤ (Real.exp 1 * (n : ℝ) / k) ^ k
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For positive k, `choose(n,k) ≤ (exp(1)*n/k)^k`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 20]. The estimate holds even when k>n; unlike the paper's presentation, it need not assume a nonzero binomial coefficient.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucket_tail {m B : ℕ} [NeZero B] (S : Finset (Fin m)) (b : Fin B) (t : ℕ) : uprob (fun φ : Fin m → Fin B => t < (Buckets.bucket φ b ∩ S).card) ≤ (Nat.choose S.card (t + 1) : ℝ) / (B : ℝ) ^ (t + 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For uniform bucket placement, a fixed bucket contains more than t elements of a fixed set S with probability at most `choose(|S|,t+1)/B^(t+1)`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 20]. Disclosed refinement: the strict load threshold uses t+1 distinct witnesses, including t=0 and thresholds at least |S|.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem some_bucket_tail {m B : ℕ} [NeZero B] (S : Finset (Fin m)) (t : ℕ) : uprob (fun φ : Fin m → Fin B => ∃ b : Fin B, t < (Buckets.bucket φ b ∩ S).card) ≤ (B : ℝ) * ((Nat.choose S.card (t + 1) : ℝ) / (B : ℝ) ^ (t + 1))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: For uniform placement, some bucket contains more than t elements of S with probability at most `B*choose(|S|,t+1)/B^(t+1)`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 20]. Disclosed refinement: the finite strict-threshold estimate uses t+1, and counts all B buckets explicitly.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem full_bucket_tail {m B : ℕ} [NeZero B] (b : Fin B) (t : ℕ) : uprob (fun φ : Fin m → Fin B => t < Buckets.load φ b) ≤ (Nat.choose m (t + 1) : ℝ) / (B : ℝ) ^ (t + 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A fixed bucket's full load exceeds t with probability at most `choose(m,t+1)/B^(t+1)`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 20]. Disclosed refinement: this uses the t+1-element witness for a strictly overflowing load.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem some_full_bucket_tail {m B : ℕ} [NeZero B] (t : ℕ) : uprob (fun φ : Fin m → Fin B => ∃ b : Fin B, t < Buckets.load φ b) ≤ (B : ℝ) * ((Nat.choose m (t + 1) : ℝ) / (B : ℝ) ^ (t + 1))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Some bucket's full load exceeds t with probability at most `B*choose(m,t+1)/B^(t+1)`. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.2, p. 20]. Disclosed refinement: the finite bound keeps the exact strict-threshold witness and explicit bucket factor.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem firstGood_none_iff {κ : ℕ} (flags : Fin κ → Bool) : firstGood flags = none ↔ ∀ k, flags k = false
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: An absent first success means every flag is false, `firstGood flags = none ↔ ∀ k, flags k = false` [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 15]. The increasing finite search remains meaningful when there are no repetitions.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem firstGood_some_flag {κ : ℕ} (flags : Fin κ → Bool) (k : Fin κ) (h : firstGood flags = some k) : flags k = true
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A selected first repetition has a true flag, `firstGood flags = some k → flags k = true` [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 15]. This is mathematical glue for deterministic flag selection.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem firstGood_some_minimal {κ : ℕ} (flags : Fin κ → Bool) (k : Fin κ) (h : firstGood flags = some k) (q : Fin κ) (hq : q < k) : flags q = false
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every index earlier than the selected first success has a false flag [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 15]. This is mathematical glue for the deterministic minimum.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem packSeed_public_block (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) (k : Fin κ) (i : Fin (P.n κ)) : (P.packSeed κ pp instances first).1 (P.pubEquiv κ (.inl (k, i))) = (instances k).pub i
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Packing preserves each instance's public vector at its explicit block coordinate [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv15 uses the public Fin equivalence; this is coordinate glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem packSeed_error (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) : (P.packSeed κ pp instances first).1 (P.pubEquiv κ (.inr ())) = (first.isNone.toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Packing publishes one exactly when no first success exists [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv15 gives the error flag its explicit public coordinate.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem packSeed_flag (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) (k : Fin κ) : (P.packSeed κ pp instances first).2 (P.privEquiv κ (k, .inl ())) = if first = some k then 1 else 0
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Packing gives flag one only to the selected repetition [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv15 uses the explicit private-coordinate equivalence.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem packSeed_unscaled (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) (k : Fin κ) (v : P.SVar κ) : (P.packSeed κ pp instances first).2 (P.privEquiv κ (k, .inr (.inl v))) = (instances k).priv v
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Packing preserves all original private seed coordinates [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv15 fixes the original-copy positions.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem packSeed_scaled (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) (k : Fin κ) (v : P.SVar κ) : (P.packSeed κ pp instances first).2 (P.privEquiv κ (k, .inr (.inr v))) = (if first = some k then (1 : ZMod pp.p) else 0) * (instances k).priv v
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Packing precomputes the selected flag times every private seed coordinate [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv10 and Dv15 put flag*S in a separate private copy.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem oneFlag_bounds (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (h : P.oneFlag κ pp I e = true) : (P.badSet κ pp I e).card ≤ P.Γ κ ∧ ¬ Buckets.overfull I.2.1 (P.rc κ * P.rc κ) ∧ ∀ b : Fin (P.B κ), (Buckets.bucket I.2.1 b ∩ P.badSet κ pp I e).card ≤ P.t κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Success bounds the bad count, rules out overfull grids, and bounds every bucket's bad count [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 uses the stated integer rounding; the squared grid capacity is read through its published equation.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem corr_zero_of_not_bad (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (h : j ∉ P.badSet κ pp I e) : P.corr κ pp I σ e j = 0
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A good output has zero correction, `j ∉ BAD → Corr_j = 0` [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16; Equation (3), p. 17]. Dv4 uses the representation's variable set, so the erroneous and correct assignments agree there.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem oneSd_factors_mul (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) (h : (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).flag = true) (b : Fin (P.B κ)) : (Matrix.of (fun row a => (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).priv (P.uCoord κ b row a)) : Matrix (Fin (P.rc κ)) (Fin (P.t κ)) (ZMod pp.p)) * (Matrix.of (fun a col => (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).priv (P.vCoord κ b a col)) : Matrix (Fin (P.t κ)) (Fin (P.rc κ)) (ZMod pp.p)) = Buckets.bucketMatrix I.2.1 (P.rc κ) (P.corr κ pp I σ (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp (r i))) b
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Successful one-instance factors reconstruct every bucket correction matrix [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. The deterministic sparse factorization replaces the paper's rank-existence justification while keeping the same dimensions.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G1_eval_of_good (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (z : P.Var κ → ZMod pp.p) (hpub : ∀ i, z (P.bVar κ k i) = (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).pub i) (hpriv : ∀ v, z (P.sVar κ k false v) = (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).priv v) (hgood : j ∉ P.badSet κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp (r i))) : MvPolynomial.eval z (P.G1 κ pp I k j) = ((P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 σ (P.outputIndex κ j)).toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The first map already agrees with the correct Boolean output at every good coordinate [JLS26, Equation (3), p. 17]. Dv3 transposes the matrix and Dv4 identifies good outputs using the supplied multilinear representation.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem correctionPoly_eval_oneSd (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (z : P.Var κ → ZMod pp.p) (hpriv : ∀ v, z (P.sVar κ k false v) = (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).priv v) (hflag : (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).flag = true) : MvPolynomial.eval z (P.correctionPoly κ pp I k j false) = P.corr κ pp I σ (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp (r i)) j
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A successful instance's quadratic correction evaluates to the original correction entry [JLS26, Equation (3), p. 17]. The good-case optional grid position exists and is injective.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G2_eval_of_flag (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (z : P.Var κ → ZMod pp.p) (hpub : ∀ i, z (P.bVar κ k i) = (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).pub i) (hpriv : ∀ v, z (P.sVar κ k false v) = (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).priv v) (hflag : (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).flag = true) : MvPolynomial.eval z (P.G2 κ pp I k j) = ((P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 σ (P.outputIndex κ j)).toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The second map equals the correct Boolean output whenever its instance flag is true [JLS26, Equation (3), p. 17]. Dv3 uses the transposed public vector, and the private coordinates use the explicit deterministic factors rather than an unspecified witness.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G4_eval_sdCore (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim (P.sdCore κ pp I d).seed.1 (P.sdCore κ pp I d).seed.2) (P.G4 κ pp I j) = if (P.sdCore κ pp I d).err then 0 else ((P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 d.1 (P.outputIndex κ j)).toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The fourth map at every exact core draw equals zero on error and the PRG output otherwise [JLS26, Eval', pp. 16-17]. Dv10 uses the precomputed scaled copy, and Dv15 transports structured assignments by the explicit public/private equivalences. No positive-κ premise is needed: an empty repetition set evaluates to zero and has its error flag set.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G4_eval_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : (P.sdSampFull κ pp I).AllOutputs (fun x => ∀ j, MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim x.seed.1 x.seed.2) (P.G4 κ pp I j) = if x.err then 0 else ((P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 x.σ (P.outputIndex κ j)).toNat : ZMod pp.p))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every full sampled output satisfies `G4 = (1-err) Eval` [JLS26, Eval', pp. 16-17]. Dv10 and Dv15 retain the formal degree and explicit renaming; Dv17 states exact support correctness, uniformly for every κ and input prime.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem eval'_correct (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : (P.sdSampFull κ pp I).AllOutputs (fun x => ∀ j, P.eval' κ pp I x.seed j = if x.err then false else P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 x.σ (P.outputIndex κ j))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every full sampled output has Boolean evaluation zero on error and the correct PRG output otherwise [JLS26, Eval', pp. 16-17]. Dv17 uses exact support correctness; primality gives distinct field encodings of zero and one, including p=2.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem Params.G4_seed_allOutputs (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : (P.sdSamp' κ pp I).AllOutputs (fun sd => ∀ j, ((P.eval' κ pp I sd j).toNat : ZMod pp.p) = MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim sd.1 sd.2) (P.G4 κ pp I j))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every sampled seed evaluates G4 to the field encoding of Eval′; algebraic glue. [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10; Equation (4), p. 17]. This theorem-only helper preserves the specific G4 witness for both complexity links.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jls_hasComplexity (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).HasComplexity P.d 2
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw JLS generator has public degree d and private degree two [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10; Eval', pp. 16-17]. Dv6 uses the composite polynomial form; Dv10 uses degree d from the formal construction. Dv15 uses Fin seed coordinates, and Dv18 keeps efficiency separate in the raw bundle until assembly from targets.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure PrimeParam (κ : ℕ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A public prime has `2^κ ≤ p ≤ 2^(κ+1)` [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10; §4, p. 15]. Dv9: the prime is an input, rather than a computed schedule; the boundary κ = 0 admits p = 2. No algorithm chooses a prime.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: instance PrimeParam.instNeZero {κ : ℕ} (pp : PrimeParam κ) : NeZero pp.p
instance PrimeParam.instFact {κ : ℕ} (pp : PrimeParam κ) : Fact pp.p.Prime
def PrimeParam.enc {κ : ℕ} (pp : PrimeParam κ) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The public numeral is p in κ+2 bits [JLS26, §4, p. 15]. Dv9: the extra bit includes the κ=0 boundary and makes the parameter public on the wire.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem PrimeParam.enc_eq {κ : ℕ} (pp : PrimeParam κ) : pp.enc = Candidates.natToList (κ + 2) pp.p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The encoding is `natToList (κ+2) p`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev PrimeSchedule : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A prime schedule assigns one public prime to every κ [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. Dv9: no computability is assumed; results quantify all schedules and honest algorithms receive each prime as input.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem primeSchedule_eq : PrimeSchedule = ((κ : ℕ) → PrimeParam κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A schedule is a function selecting a PrimeParam at every κ; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem PrimeSchedule.nonempty : Nonempty PrimeSchedule
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A schedule exists by Bertrand's postulate; glue for non-vacuity of [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. This existence is never a prime algorithm.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure Raw
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: An exact-law structured-seed algorithm bundle over a public prime [JLS26, Definitions 3.1-3.3, p. 10]. Dv1-Dv2 and Dv15: one parameter and Fin-indexed field-vector seeds. Dv17-Dv18: draws and deterministic cores specify exact laws; efficiency is added by SPRG, never asserted by Raw. The public modulus is carried on every sPRG challenge (Dv9).

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: instance instIdxFintype (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : Fintype (S.Idx κ)
instance instIdxNonempty (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : Nonempty (S.Idx κ)
instance instIdDrawFintype (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : Fintype (S.IdDraw κ)
instance instIdDrawNonempty (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : Nonempty (S.IdDraw κ)
instance instSdDrawFintype (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) : Fintype (S.SdDraw κ I)
instance instSdDrawNonempty (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) : Nonempty (S.SdDraw κ I)
instance instModulusNeZero (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : NeZero (S.modulus κ)
theorem instIdxFintype_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : instIdxFintype S κ = S.idxFintype κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index finiteness instance is its stored raw field; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem instIdDrawFintype_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : instIdDrawFintype S κ = S.idDrawFintype κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index-draw finiteness instance is its stored raw field; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem instSdDrawFintype_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) : instSdDrawFintype S κ I = S.sdDrawFintype κ I
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed-draw finiteness instance is its stored raw field; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev Seed (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed is a public/private vector pair [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv2 and Dv15 use fixed-width field vectors, indexed by Fin.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem seed_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : S.Seed κ = ((Fin (S.pubLen κ) → ZMod (S.modulus κ)) × (Fin (S.privLen κ) → ZMod (S.modulus κ)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed type is the public/private pair; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def idSamp (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp (S.Idx κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: IdSamp is the exact pushforward of the index draw [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv17-Dv18: the sampler contract is separate.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idSamp_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : S.idSamp κ = S.idCore κ <$> ProbComp.sample (S.IdDraw κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: IdSamp maps idCore over the uniform draw; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def sdSamp (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) : ProbComp (S.Seed κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: SdSamp is the exact pushforward of the joint seed draw [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv17-Dv18: no coin sampler is constructed.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdSamp_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) : S.sdSamp κ I = S.sdCore κ I <$> ProbComp.sample (S.SdDraw κ I)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: SdSamp maps sdCore over its one exact draw; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def encPP (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The modulus is encoded in residueBits+1 bits [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. Dv9 makes the modulus public rather than computing it.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encPP_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : S.encPP κ = Candidates.natToList (S.residueBits.eval κ + 1) (S.modulus κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The public parameter is the fixed-width numeral; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def encSeed (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (sd : S.Seed κ) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Encode both field-vector seeds [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv2 and Dv15 fix increasing Fin-coordinate order.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encSeed_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (sd : S.Seed κ) : S.encSeed κ sd = pairEncode (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (S.residueBits.eval κ) sd.1) (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (S.residueBits.eval κ) sd.2)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed encoding pairs the two vector encodings; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def challengeStr (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) (pub : Fin (S.pubLen κ) → ZMod (S.modulus κ)) (z : Fin (S.outLen κ) → Bool) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: An sPRG challenge is pp, index, public seed, output [JLS26, Definition 3.2, p. 10]. Dv9 prepends the public modulus.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem challengeStr_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) (pub : Fin (S.pubLen κ) → ZMod (S.modulus κ)) (z : Fin (S.outLen κ) → Bool) : S.challengeStr κ I pub z = pairEncode (S.encPP κ) (pairEncode (S.encIdx κ I) (pairEncode (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (S.residueBits.eval κ) pub) (List.ofFn z)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The challenge has pp as its first field; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def game (S : Raw) (A : NUPPT) (real : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : ProbComp Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The real or random game samples index, joint seed and adversary coins [JLS26, Definition 3.2, p. 10]. Dv1 uses κ alone; Dv9 publishes p.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem game_eq (S : Raw) (A : NUPPT) (real : Bool) (κ : ℕ) : S.game A real κ = (S.idSamp κ).bind fun I => (S.sdSamp κ I).bind fun sd => (ProbComp.sample (Fin (S.outLen κ) → Bool)).bind fun z => (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins κ)).bind fun r => pure (A.distinguisherL κ (S.challengeStr κ I sd.1 (if real then S.eval κ I sd else z)) r)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The game is the stated sequence of exact laws; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def adv (S : Raw) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) : ℝ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advantage is the absolute real/random acceptance gap [JLS26, Definition 3.2, p. 10; Definition 2.1, p. 9]. Dv13 uses NUPPT adversaries.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem adv_eq (S : Raw) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) : S.adv A κ = advantage (S.game A true κ) (S.game A false κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advantage is the game advantage; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def Secure (S : Raw) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Security means negligible advantage for every NUPPT [JLS26, Definition 3.2, p. 10]. Dv13 fixes this adversary class.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem secure_iff (S : Raw) : S.Secure ↔ ∀ A : NUPPT, Negligible (S.adv A)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Security quantifies all NUPPT adversaries; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def SubexpSecure (S : Raw) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Subexponential security is the shared SubexpHard predicate [JLS26, Definition 2.1, p. 9]. Dv13 bounds advantage, not adversary running time.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem subexpSecure_iff (S : Raw) : S.SubexpSecure ↔ SubexpHard S.adv
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Subexponential security is exactly SubexpHard; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def seedBits (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Seed bit length is the total residue count times its width [JLS26, Remark 3.2, p. 10]. Dv1-Dv2 count the single-index vector encoding.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem seedBits_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : S.seedBits κ = (S.pubLen κ + S.privLen κ) * S.residueBits.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Seed bits are (public+private length) times residueBits; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasPolyStretch (S : Raw) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Polynomial stretch expands seed bits by some exponent greater than one [JLS26, Remark 3.1, p. 10]. Dv1 is the fixed polynomial schedule form. SP-W3 also requires seed bits to be at least κ eventually, excluding constant-length vacuity in the single-parameter existence statements.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasPolyStretch_iff (S : Raw) : S.HasPolyStretch ↔ ∃ τ : ℝ, 1 < τ ∧ ∃ κ₀, ∀ κ ≥ κ₀, κ ≤ S.seedBits κ ∧ (S.seedBits κ : ℝ) ^ τ ≤ S.outLen κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Polynomial stretch has eventual seed growth and a real-power output bound; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasComplexity (S : Raw) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Complexity is a bidegree-bounded polynomial on every sampled seed [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. Dv6 restricts the public class to degree and uses one composite polynomial; Dv15 uses Fin variables. The predicate quantifies every index, a strengthening of the support-only condition.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasComplexity_iff (S : Raw) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : S.HasComplexity dPub dPriv ↔ ∀ κ (I : S.Idx κ), ∃ Q : Fin (S.outLen κ) → MvPolynomial (Fin (S.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (S.privLen κ)) (ZMod (S.modulus κ)), (∀ j, pubDegree (Q j) ≤ dPub ∧ privDegree (Q j) ≤ dPriv) ∧ (S.sdSamp κ I).AllOutputs fun sd => ∀ j, ((S.eval κ I sd j).toNat : ZMod (S.modulus κ)) = MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim sd.1 sd.2) (Q j)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Complexity supplies the stated degree and evaluation witnesses; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def EvalEfficient (S : Raw) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Eval efficiency is one uniform map with p on its input [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv9 and Dv18 supply the modulus and defer proof.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem evalEfficient_iff (S : Raw) : S.EvalEfficient ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ κ I sd, f (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode (S.encPP κ) (pairEncode (S.encIdx κ I) (S.encSeed κ sd)))) = List.ofFn (S.eval κ I sd)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Eval efficiency has its one-map characterization; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def idWord (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The sampler word contains unary κ and pp [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv17: the shared sampler contract indexes draw types by this word.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idWord_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) : S.idWord κ = pairEncode (S.encPP κ) (List.replicate κ true)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index-draw word pairs pp and unary κ; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def sdWord (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed-sampler word contains pp, unary κ and index [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv17 uses one jointly sampled draw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdWord_eq (S : Raw) (κ : ℕ) (I : S.Idx κ) : S.sdWord κ I = pairEncode (S.encPP κ) (pairEncode (List.replicate κ true) (S.encIdx κ I))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed-draw word contains its public inputs; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasComplexityEff (S : Raw) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Efficient complexity generates the actual degree-bounded output polynomials from pp and index [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. Dv6 uses finite term lists for the composite polynomial; Dv18 defers efficiency.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasComplexityEff_iff (S : Raw) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : S.HasComplexityEff dPub dPriv ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ κ (I : S.Idx κ), ∃ Q : Fin (S.outLen κ) → MvPolynomial (Fin (S.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (S.privLen κ)) (ZMod (S.modulus κ)), (∀ j, ∃ ts : PolyTerms (Fin (S.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (S.privLen κ)) (ZMod (S.modulus κ)), f (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode (S.encPP κ) (pairEncode (S.encIdx κ I) (PolyTerms.encFin j)))) = PolyTerms.encTerms (fun z => Candidates.natToList (S.residueBits.eval κ) z.val) (fun v => PolyTerms.encFin (finSumFinEquiv v)) ts ∧ PolyTerms.denote ts = Q j) ∧ (∀ j, pubDegree (Q j) ≤ dPub ∧ privDegree (Q j) ≤ dPriv) ∧ (S.sdSamp κ I).AllOutputs fun sd => ∀ j, ((S.eval κ I sd j).toNat : ZMod (S.modulus κ)) = MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim sd.1 sd.2) (Q j)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Efficient complexity is exactly the term-list generation contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem HasComplexityEff.hasComplexity {S : Raw} {dPub dPriv : ℕ} (h : S.HasComplexityEff dPub dPriv) : S.HasComplexity dPub dPriv
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Efficient complexity implies complexity [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. This is glue forgetting the generation algorithm.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure SPRG extends SPRG.Raw
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A structured-seed primitive carries all honest efficiency fields [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv17-Dv18 add uniform exact-on-success sampler contracts to the raw exact laws. No instance omits efficiency.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def Secure (S : SPRG) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive security reads security of its raw bundle [JLS26, Definition 3.2, p. 10]. Dv18 keeps algorithm and efficiency layers distinct.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem secure_iff (S : SPRG) : S.Secure ↔ S.toRaw.Secure
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive security is raw security; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasComplexity (S : SPRG) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive complexity reads raw complexity [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. Dv18 adds the honest efficiency fields separately.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasComplexity_iff (S : SPRG) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : S.HasComplexity dPub dPriv ↔ S.toRaw.HasComplexity dPub dPriv
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive complexity is raw complexity; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasComplexityEff (S : SPRG) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive efficient complexity generates its output polynomials [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10]. Dv18 reads the raw predicate.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasComplexityEff_iff (S : SPRG) (dPub dPriv : ℕ) : S.HasComplexityEff dPub dPriv ↔ S.toRaw.HasComplexityEff dPub dPriv
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive efficient complexity is raw efficient complexity; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def HasPolyStretch (S : SPRG) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive stretch reads its raw seed-bit count [JLS26, Remark 3.1, p. 10]. Dv18 adds efficiency without changing the lengths.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasPolyStretch_iff (S : SPRG) : S.HasPolyStretch ↔ S.toRaw.HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive stretch is raw stretch; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def adv (S : SPRG) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) : ℝ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive advantage reads its raw game advantage [JLS26, Definition 3.2, p. 10]. Dv18 changes no experiment.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem adv_eq (S : SPRG) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) : S.adv A κ = S.toRaw.adv A κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Primitive advantage equals raw advantage; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def pubDegree (q : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) R) : ℕ

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encIdx'_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : P.encIdx' κ pp I = pairEncode (P.G.encIdx (P.n κ) I.1) (pairEncode (P.encBuckets κ I.2.1) (Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix (κ + 1) I.2.2))

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def encIdDraw (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (r : P.IdDraw κ pp) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index draw has the same bucket/matrix code with `G.encIdDraw` for the generator draw. [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv17 retains the complete exact draw for the shared contract.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encIdDraw_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (r : P.IdDraw κ pp) : P.encIdDraw κ pp r = pairEncode (P.G.encIdDraw (P.n κ) r.1) (pairEncode (P.encBuckets κ r.2.1) (Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix (κ + 1) r.2.2))

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def encOneDraw (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (r : (Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) × (Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p)) : List Bool
