[JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 uses the exact `Fin W` selector; Dv15 gives selectors `ell+1` bits and residues `kappa+1` bits.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encOneDraw_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (r : (Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) × (Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p)) : P.encOneDraw κ pp r = pairEncode (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (κ + 1) r.1) (BoolCircuit.encodeList (fun c : Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p => pairEncode (Candidates.natToList (P.ℓ κ + 1) c.1.val) (Candidates.natToList (κ + 1) c.2.val)) (List.ofFn r.2))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: One repetition has the displayed vector-and-noise-list code; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def encDraw (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (r : P.Draw κ pp) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The entire seed draw pairs the actual Boolean seed word with the finite list of kappa secret/noise repetitions. [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv15 and Dv17 retain all exact draw data with explicit coordinates and no classical enumeration.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encDraw_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (r : P.Draw κ pp) : P.encDraw κ pp r = pairEncode (List.ofFn r.1) (BoolCircuit.encodeList (P.encOneDraw κ pp) (List.ofFn r.2))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The entire seed-draw code is the displayed Boolean/repetition pair; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def encSeed' (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (sd : P.Seed κ pp) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The published seed is the pair of canonical modular vector codes at residue width `kappa+1`. [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv2 and Dv15 use explicit public/private Fin coordinates.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encSeed'_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (sd : P.Seed κ pp) : P.encSeed' κ pp sd = pairEncode (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (κ + 1) sd.1) (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (κ + 1) sd.2)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed code is the stated pair of fixed-width vector codes; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def ellBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The LPN dimension bound is the syntactic polynomial `var^E`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem ellBound_eq (P : Params) : P.ellBound = .pow .var P.E
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The dimension bound is `var^E`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def nBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean seed bound is the syntactic polynomial `(var^E)^D`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem nBound_eq (P : Params) : P.nBound = .pow P.ellBound P.D
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean seed bound is `ellBound^D`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def mBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The output bound substitutes the seed polynomial into the Boolean output bound; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem mBound_eq (P : Params) : P.mBound = P.G.outBound.subst P.nBound
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The output bound is `G.outBound.subst nBound`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def bucketBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The bucket bound is the syntactic polynomial `mBound*var+1`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem bucketBound_eq (P : Params) : P.bucketBound = .add (.mul P.mBound .var) (.const 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The bucket bound is `mBound*var+1`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def rcBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The grid-side bound is the syntactic polynomial `var*(ellBound+1)`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem rcBound_eq (P : Params) : P.rcBound = .mul .var (.add P.ellBound (.const 1))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The grid-side bound is `var*(ellBound+1)`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def pubBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The public-length bound is the syntactic polynomial `var*nBound+1`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem pubBound_eq (P : Params) : P.pubBound = .add (.mul .var P.nBound) (.const 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The public-length bound is `var*nBound+1`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def sVarBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The one-instance private bound is `(ellBound+1)^D` plus the two factor-array bounds; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sVarBound_eq (P : Params) : P.sVarBound = .add (.pow (.add P.ellBound (.const 1)) P.D) (.mul P.bucketBound (.add (.mul P.rcBound .var) (.mul .var P.rcBound)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The one-instance private bound is the displayed tensor/factor polynomial; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def seedBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The common seed bound is `pubBound + var*(1+2*sVarBound)`; glue. Both public and private residue counts are bounded by this one syntactic polynomial.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem seedBound_eq (P : Params) : P.seedBound = .add P.pubBound (.mul .var (.add (.const 1) (.mul (.const 2) P.sVarBound)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The common seed bound is the displayed public/private sum; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def idxBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index bit bound includes the Boolean index, both pair separators, the bucket list, and the matrix residues. [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv15 counts the fixed concrete code; the exact pair cost is `2|x|+2+|y|` and bucket-list cost is `m*(B+1)+1`.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idxBound_eq (P : Params) : P.idxBound = .add (.mul (.const 2) (P.G.idxBits.subst P.nBound)) (.add (.const 6) (.add (.mul (.const 2) (.mul P.mBound (.add P.bucketBound (.const 1)))) (.mul (.mul P.nBound P.ellBound) (.add .var (.const 1)))))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index bound is the explicit pair/list/matrix polynomial; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem ell_le_ellBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.ℓ κ ≤ P.ellBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The scheduled LPN dimension is bounded by `ellBound`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem n_le_nBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.n κ ≤ P.nBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The scheduled Boolean seed length is bounded by `nBound`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem m_le_mBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.m κ ≤ P.mBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The scheduled output length is bounded by `mBound`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem W_le_ell_add_one (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.W κ ≤ P.ℓ κ + 1
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The rounded noise denominator satisfies `W ≤ ell+1` at every parameter. [JLS26, Section 4, p. 15]. Dv3 rounds the noise rate upward; SP-W1 supplies `0<delta<1`.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem W_le_two_pow_ell_add_one (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.W κ ≤ 2 ^ (P.ℓ κ + 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every noise selector fits in `ell+1` bits. [JLS26, Section 4, p. 15]. Dv15 fixes the finite selector code used by the exact draw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem B_le_bucketBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.B κ ≤ P.bucketBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The rounded bucket count is bounded by `bucketBound`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem rc_le_rcBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.rc κ ≤ P.rcBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The grid side is bounded by `rcBound`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sLen_le_sVarBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.sLen κ ≤ P.sVarBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The one-instance private length is bounded by `sVarBound`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem pubLen_le_seedBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.pubLen κ ≤ P.seedBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The public residue count is bounded by the common seed polynomial. [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv2 counts the field-vector coordinates.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem privLen_le_seedBound (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.privLen κ ≤ P.seedBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The private residue count is bounded by the common seed polynomial. [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv2 counts flag and both private-vector copies.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encBuckets_injective (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : Function.Injective (P.encBuckets κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The bucket-placement code retains every finite coordinate. [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv15 makes faithfulness explicit.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encIdx'_injective (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : Function.Injective (P.encIdx' κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The construction index code retains the complete Boolean index, bucket placement and matrix. [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv15 makes faithfulness explicit.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encIdDraw_injective (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : Function.Injective (P.encIdDraw κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The exact index-draw code retains every draw component. [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv15 and Dv17 make the exact-draw encoding faithful.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encOneDraw_injective (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : Function.Injective (P.encOneDraw κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: One repetition's code retains its common secret and every selector/residue pair. [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 and Dv15 fix the exact noise draw and its widths.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encDraw_injective (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : Function.Injective (P.encDraw κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The complete seed-draw code retains the Boolean seed and every exact repetition draw. [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv15 and Dv17 make the exact-draw code faithful.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encSeed'_injective (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : Function.Injective (P.encSeed' κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The published seed code retains both field-vector components. [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 16]. Dv2 and Dv15 use canonical residue codes.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encIdx'_length_le (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : (P.encIdx' κ pp I).length ≤ P.idxBound.eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every encoded construction index fits the syntactic polynomial `idxBound`. [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv15 accounts for every pair, list tag and residue bit.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: inductive HybridStage
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The four distributions are real output, PRG output with zero error flag, uniform output with zero error flag, and the random comparison game [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv8 also publishes the independent bucket map.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def publicSeed (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (bs : Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (err : Bool) : Fin (P.pubLen κ) → ZMod pp.p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A public seed packs κ vectors and one Boolean error flag [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv15 uses the fixed public-coordinate equivalence.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem publicSeed_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (bs : Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (err : Bool) : P.publicSeed κ pp bs err = fun i => match (P.pubEquiv κ).symm i with | .inl (k, q) => bs k q | .inr _ => (err.toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Public seed packing follows the explicit vector/flag coordinate split; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def chainPublic (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) (u : Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (i : ℕ) : Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The ith chain public component replaces exactly the first i LPN vectors by uniforms [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv8 retains the bucket map; no core computes a Boolean tail.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem chainPublic_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) (u : Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (i : ℕ) : P.chainPublic κ pp I d u i = fun k => if k.val < i then u k else P.lpnVector κ pp I.2.2 d.1 (d.2 k).1 (d.2 k).2
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Chain public vectors follow the first-i replacement rule; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def chainGame (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (tailReal : Bool) (i κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : ProbComp Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A chain game chooses either the PRG tail or a uniform Boolean tail, and publishes zero as its error flag [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv8 retains independent buckets; Dv12 prepares the two advice-based hybrid chains used by the reductions.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem chainGame_eq (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (tailReal : Bool) (i κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.chainGame A tailReal i κ pp = (P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I => (ProbComp.sample (P.Draw κ pp)).bind fun d => (ProbComp.sample (Fin κ → Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p)).bind fun u => (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.m κ) → Bool)).bind fun w => (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins κ)).bind fun r => pure (A.distinguisherL κ (P.challengeStr κ pp I (P.publicSeed κ pp (P.chainPublic κ pp I d u i) false) (if tailReal then fun j => P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 d.1 (P.outputIndex κ j) else w)) r)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The chain game is its explicit sequence of exact finite laws; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdCore_publicSeed (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : (P.sdCore κ pp I d).seed.1 = P.publicSeed κ pp (fun k => ((P.sdCore κ pp I d).instances k).pub) (P.sdCore κ pp I d).err
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The packed core publishes its instance vectors and its actual error bit; glue. [JLS26, SdSamp′, pp. 15-16]. This theorem compares the deterministic vector maps.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def hyb (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (stage : HybridStage) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : ProbComp Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: H0-H3 sample the actual index and seed law and alter only error flag and output [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv8 includes the bucket map in all challenges.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hyb_eq (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (stage : HybridStage) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.hyb A stage κ pp = (P.idSamp' κ pp).bind fun I => (P.sdSampFull κ pp I).bind fun x => (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.m κ) → Bool)).bind fun w => (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins κ)).bind fun r => let clean
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The four hybrids have their displayed error-flag/output substitutions; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hyb_real_eq_raw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) : P.hyb A .real κ (π κ) = (jlsSPRG_raw P π).game A true κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: H0 equals the real raw sPRG game [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv18 uses Raw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hyb_random_eq_raw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) : P.hyb A .random κ (π κ) = (jlsSPRG_raw P π).game A false κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: H3 equals the random raw sPRG game [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv18 uses Raw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hyb_prg_accept_eq_chain_zero (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : accept (P.hyb A .prg κ pp) = accept (P.chainGame A true 0 κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: H1 and the real-tail chain's initial game have equal acceptance probabilities [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv8 includes buckets. Pre-M0 repair SP-W2 compares probabilities: the free oracle programs differ by an unused uniform-vector query.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hyb_uniform_accept_eq_chain_zero (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : accept (P.hyb A .uniform κ pp) = accept (P.chainGame A false 0 κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: H2 and the uniform-tail chain's initial game have equal acceptance probabilities [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Pre-M0 repair SP-W2 compares probabilities rather than free oracle syntax, since the chain makes an additional unused uniform-vector query.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hyb_real_prg_le (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : advantage (P.hyb A .real κ pp) (P.hyb A .prg κ pp) ≤ P.errProb κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: H0 and H1 disagree only on the error event [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv7 retains the exact error probability at every parameter.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hyb_uniform_random_le (P : Params) (A : NUPPT) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : advantage (P.hyb A .uniform κ pp) (P.hyb A .random κ pp) ≤ P.errProb κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: H2 and H3 disagree only on the error event [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv7 retains the exact error probability at every parameter.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnNoise (p W : ℕ) [NeZero p] [NeZero W] : LWE.Noise
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: LPN noise is zero except when the uniform selector is zero, when it is uniform modulo `p`: `sample (a,x) = if a = 0 then x.val else 0`. [JLS26, before Definition 2.3, p. 9]. Deviation Dv3: the exact finite rate is `1/W`; residues are represented by integer lifts to reuse `LWE.Noise`, and the construction supplies the rounded denominator.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def linearCoeff (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (slot : Option (Fin (P.n κ))) (a : Fin (P.ℓ κ + 1)) : P.StructPoly κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def prgPoly (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (copy : Bool) : P.StructPoly κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgPoly_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (copy : Bool) : P.prgPoly κ pp I' k j copy = ∑ h ∈ (P.R.poly (P.n κ) I'.1 (P.outputIndex κ j)).support, MvPolynomial.C ((MvPolynomial.coeff h (P.R.poly (P.n κ) I'.1 (P.outputIndex κ j)) : ℤ) : ZMod pp.p) * P.halfForm κ pp I' k h 0 copy * P.halfForm κ pp I' k h P.D false

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def correctionPoly (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (copy : Bool) : P.StructPoly κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem correctionPoly_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (copy : Bool) : P.correctionPoly κ pp I' k j copy = match Buckets.indexMap I'.2.1 (P.rc κ) j with | none => 0 | some c => ∑ r : Fin (P.t κ), MvPolynomial.X (P.sVar κ k copy (P.uCoord κ (I'.2.1 j) c.1 r)) * MvPolynomial.X (P.sVar κ k false (P.vCoord κ (I'.2.1 j) r c.2))

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def G1 (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.StructPoly κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The first map is the lifted PRG evaluation on the unscaled seed copy, `G1 = prgPoly false` [JLS26, Equation (3), p. 17]. TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G1_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.G1 κ pp I' k j = P.prgPoly κ pp I' k j false

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def G2 (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.StructPoly κ pp

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G2_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.G2 κ pp I' k j = P.G1 κ pp I' k j + P.correctionPoly κ pp I' k j false

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The third map scales each quadratic term's first private factor through flag*S, `G3 = prgPoly true + correctionPoly true` [JLS26, Equation (4), p. 17]. Dv10 keeps public degree d and private degree two; flag multiplication is precomputed in the seed.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G3_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.G3 κ pp I' k j = P.prgPoly κ pp I' k j true + P.correctionPoly κ pp I' k j true

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G4struct_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.G4struct κ pp I' j = ∑ k : Fin κ, P.G3 κ pp I' k j

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def G4 (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : MvPolynomial (Fin (P.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (P.privLen κ)) (ZMod pp.p)

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G4_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.G4 κ pp I' j = MvPolynomial.rename (Equiv.sumCongr (P.pubEquiv κ) (P.privEquiv κ)) (P.G4struct κ pp I' j)

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem halfForm_pubDegree_le (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (h : Fin (P.n κ) →₀ ℕ) (offset : ℕ) (copy : Bool) : pubDegree (P.halfForm κ pp I' k h offset copy) ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun r : Fin P.D => (Internal.monomialSlot h (offset + r.val)).isSome)).card

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgPoly_degrees (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (copy : Bool) : pubDegree (P.prgPoly κ pp I' k j copy) ≤ P.d ∧ privDegree (P.prgPoly κ pp I' k j copy) ≤ 2

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G4_degrees (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : pubDegree (P.G4 κ pp I' j) ≤ P.d ∧ privDegree (P.G4 κ pp I' j) ≤ 2

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem halfForm_eval (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (h : Fin (P.n κ) →₀ ℕ) (offset : ℕ) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (x : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (z : P.Var κ → ZMod pp.p) (hpub : ∀ i, z (P.bVar κ k i) = (∑ a, I'.2.2 i a * s a) + x i) (htensor : ∀ α : Fin P.D → Fin (P.ℓ κ + 1), z (P.sVar κ k false (.inl α)) = ∏ r : Fin P.D, if ha : (α r).val < P.ℓ κ then s ⟨(α r).val, ha⟩ else 1) : MvPolynomial.eval z (P.halfForm κ pp I' k h offset false) = ∏ r : Fin P.D, match Internal.monomialSlot h (offset + r.val) with | none => 1 | some i => x i

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G1_eval (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (x : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (z : P.Var κ → ZMod pp.p) (hpub : ∀ i, z (P.bVar κ k i) = (∑ a, I'.2.2 i a * s a) + x i) (htensor : ∀ α : Fin P.D → Fin (P.ℓ κ + 1), z (P.sVar κ k false (.inl α)) = ∏ r : Fin P.D, if ha : (α r).val < P.ℓ κ then s ⟨(α r).val, ha⟩ else 1) : MvPolynomial.eval z (P.G1 κ pp I' k j) = MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom (ZMod pp.p)) x (P.R.poly (P.n κ) I'.1 (P.outputIndex κ j))

Dv3 uses the transposed matrix; the coefficients are cast into the public prime field and the polynomial's multilinearity is supplied by Params.R.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem G3_eval_of_scaled (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I' : P.Idx' κ pp) (k : Fin κ) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) (z : P.Var κ → ZMod pp.p) (flag : ZMod pp.p) (hcopy : ∀ v : P.SVar κ, z (P.sVar κ k true v) = flag * z (P.sVar κ k false v)) : MvPolynomial.eval z (P.G3 κ pp I' k j) = flag * MvPolynomial.eval z (P.G2 κ pp I' k j)

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev LPNChal (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The LPN challenge is exactly the canonical challenge of the construction's LWE-family view [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv3 uses the family's independent dimension L and matrix orientation.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnChal_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.LPNChal π L = (Matrix (Fin ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).samples) (Fin ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).dimension) (ZMod ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).modulus) × (Fin ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).samples → ZMod ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).modulus))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The canonical challenge is its displayed LWE matrix/value product. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnEnc (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: LPN encoding is exactly the assumption's `LWE.encodeChallenge`, with its own residue width [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv3 changes no assumption challenge or encoding.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnEnc_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : P.lpnEnc π L x = LWE.encodeChallenge ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L) ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.residueBits.eval L) x
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The LPN encoding is the unchanged canonical family challenge code. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpn_dimension_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).dimension = L
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Canonical LPN secret dimension equals L. Glue composed from owner-side parameter readers.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpn_samples_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).samples = L ^ P.D
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Canonical LPN sample count equals L^D. Glue composed from owner-side parameter readers.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpn_modulus_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).toLWE.parameters L).modulus = (π (P.kappaOf L)).p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Canonical LPN modulus is the prime at inverse dimension. Glue composed from owner readers.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev LPNConcrete (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Concrete LPN coordinates expose rows L^D, columns L and the inverse-indexed prime [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv3 and Dv15 use only explicit transport from the assumption.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnConcrete_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.LPNConcrete π L = (Matrix (Fin (L ^ P.D)) (Fin L) (ZMod (π (P.kappaOf L)).p) × (Fin (L ^ P.D) → ZMod (π (P.kappaOf L)).p))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Concrete LPN coordinates have the displayed finite matrix/value type. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnChalEquiv (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.LPNChal π L ≃ P.LPNConcrete π L
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Canonical and concrete LPN challenges are related by explicit finite and residue casts [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv15 uses `finCongr` and `Equiv.cast`, with no chosen enumeration.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnChalEquiv_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.lpnChalEquiv π L = Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.arrowCongr (finCongr (P.lpn_samples_eq π L)) (Equiv.arrowCongr (finCongr (P.lpn_dimension_eq π L)) (Equiv.cast (congrArg ZMod (P.lpn_modulus_eq π L))))) (Equiv.arrowCongr (finCongr (P.lpn_samples_eq π L)) (Equiv.cast (congrArg ZMod (P.lpn_modulus_eq π L))))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The challenge equivalence is its explicit product/arrow/finite-cast composition. Glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure LPNAdvice (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice retains the hop, Boolean index, buckets, exact draw, Boolean tail and uniform vectors [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 hardwires averaged values rather than sampling; the extra hop sentinel `Fin (κ+1)` keeps the type inhabited at every independent dimension L.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev LPNAdviceProduct (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice has the explicit right-associated finite product of its six components. Glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnAdviceProduct_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.LPNAdviceProduct π L = (Fin (P.kappaOf L + 1) × (P.G.Idx (P.n (P.kappaOf L)) × ((Fin (P.m (P.kappaOf L)) → Fin (P.B (P.kappaOf L))) × (P.Draw (P.kappaOf L) (π (P.kappaOf L)) × ((Fin (P.m (P.kappaOf L)) → Bool) × (Fin (P.kappaOf L) → Fin (P.n (P.kappaOf L)) → ZMod (π (P.kappaOf L)).p))))))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice product is the displayed right-associated tuple. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def lpnAdviceProductEquiv (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.LPNAdvice π L ≃ P.LPNAdviceProduct π L
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice records and their explicit component products are equivalent. Glue for Dv15.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnAdviceProductEquiv_apply (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) : P.lpnAdviceProductEquiv π L w = (w.hop, w.I, w.buckets, w.draw, w.tail, w.uniform)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice-product transport reads precisely the record's six fields. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnAdviceProductEquiv_symm_apply (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdviceProduct π L) : (P.lpnAdviceProductEquiv π L).symm w = ⟨w.1, w.2.1, w.2.2.1, w.2.2.2.1, w.2.2.2.2.1, w.2.2.2.2.2⟩
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Inverse advice-product transport constructs the record from its six coordinates. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnAdviceCard (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The explicit advice coordinate count is the product of its six finite cardinalities. Glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnAdviceCard_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.lpnAdviceCard π L = let κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice coordinate count is the stated nested product. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnAdviceEquiv (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.LPNAdvice π L ≃ Fin (P.lpnAdviceCard π L)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice has explicit Fin coordinates assembled from its supplied and canonical equivalences [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv15 uses no classical finite enumeration.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnAdviceEquiv_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : P.lpnAdviceEquiv π L = let κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice Fin coordinates use the displayed tail/draw/bucket/index product composition. Glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable instance instLPNAdviceFintype (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : Fintype (P.LPNAdvice π L)
theorem instLPNAdviceFintype_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : instLPNAdviceFintype P π L = Fintype.ofEquiv (Fin (P.lpnAdviceCard π L)) (P.lpnAdviceEquiv π L).symm
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The LPN advice finiteness instance is induced by its explicit Fin equivalence; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: instance instLPNAdviceNonempty (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : Nonempty (P.LPNAdvice π L)
noncomputable def encLPNAdvice (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice encoding begins with the prime and unary L, followed by its six explicit components [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv9, Dv12 and Dv15 give the preprocessor all parameters as input; the hardwired tail avoids calling the PRG. No sampler or choice-based code occurs here.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encLPNAdvice_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) : P.encLPNAdvice π L w = let κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Advice encoding is the displayed prime-first nested pair of all six fields. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def lpnAdviceBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A syntactic bound for all encoded LPN advice is `4096*(L+1)*S(L)^3`, where S sums index, seed, output, Boolean-seed and secret bounds and L+1. Glue for Dv12 and Dv15. The generous constant bounds all nested separators without an asymptotic hidden factor.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnAdviceBound_eq (P : Params) : P.lpnAdviceBound = .mul (.const 4096) (.mul (.add .var (.const 1)) (.pow (.add P.idxBound (.add P.seedBound (.add P.mBound (.add P.nBound (.add P.ellBound (.add .var (.const 1))))))) 3))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The LPN advice bound is its displayed syntactic polynomial. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnMatrixAt (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (h : L = P.ℓ (P.kappaOf L)) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : Matrix (Fin (P.n (P.kappaOf L))) (Fin (P.ℓ (P.kappaOf L))) (ZMod (π (P.kappaOf L)).p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: On a scheduled dimension, the challenged matrix is transported to the exact κ dimensions [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv15 uses only `finCongr` and published length equations.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnMatrixAt_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (h : L = P.ℓ (P.kappaOf L)) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : P.lpnMatrixAt π L h x = fun i a => (P.lpnChalEquiv π L x).1 ((finCongr ((congrArg (fun q : ℕ => q ^ P.D) h).trans (P.n_eq (P.kappaOf L)).symm)).symm i) ((finCongr h).symm a)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The matrix transport is the displayed explicit row/column finite cast. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnValuesAt (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (h : L = P.ℓ (P.kappaOf L)) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : Fin (P.n (P.kappaOf L)) → ZMod (π (P.kappaOf L)).p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: On a scheduled dimension, challenged values use the corresponding explicit row transport [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv15 changes no challenge coordinate.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnValuesAt_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (h : L = P.ℓ (P.kappaOf L)) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : P.lpnValuesAt π L h x = fun i => (P.lpnChalEquiv π L x).2 ((finCongr ((congrArg (fun q : ℕ => q ^ P.D) h).trans (P.n_eq (P.kappaOf L)).symm)).symm i)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Value transport is the displayed row cast of the concrete challenge. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnPre (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: LPN preprocessing replaces the chosen instance by challenged values plus σ, leaves earlier instances uniform and later instances real, and publishes the hardwired tail with error zero [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 uses only advice and the challenge; it neither samples nor calls PRG evaluation. Off the schedule image it returns the empty word.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnPre_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) (x : P.LPNChal π L) : P.lpnPre π L w x = let κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: LPN preprocessing is its guarded, deterministic hybrid challenge construction. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnRed (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) (x : P.LPNChal π L) (r : List Bool) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The explicit LPN reduction invokes A at κOf(L) with preprocessing and a coin prefix [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 and Dv14 separate its typed function from its machine; advice is an input and no machine or sampler is constructed.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnRed_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) (x : P.LPNChal π L) (r : List Bool) : P.lpnRed π A L w x r = A.runAtL (P.kappaOf L) (P.lpnPre π L w x) (r.take (A.coinLen (P.kappaOf L)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The reduction calls A on its preprocessed challenge and the stated prefix. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def LPNRealizable (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: LPN realizability says every adversary and every polynomially bounded typed advice family has a machine realizing the explicit reduction. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv14 leaves this as the named Phase B obligation; the target link supplies it without constructing machines here. Dv16 uses shared RealizesOn on encoded challenges and layout-length coins only, which admits more realisers and makes this proposition easier than its every-string draft.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem LPNRealizable_iff (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : P.LPNRealizable π ↔ ∀ (A : NUPPT) (w : ∀ L, P.LPNAdvice π L), ∃ B : NUPPT, B.RealizesOn (P.lpnEnc π) (A.coins.subst .var) (fun L x r => P.lpnRed π A L (w L) x r)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: LPN realizability is the explicit contract for every adversary and advice family. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnEnc_injective (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : Function.Injective (P.lpnEnc π L)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Canonical LPN challenge encoding is injective [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv3 reuses the assumption's width and canonical encoder unchanged.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encLPNAdvice_injective (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) : Function.Injective (P.encLPNAdvice π L)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: All six hardwired advice fields are retained by the explicit code [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv9 and Dv15 place the prime first and use fixed coordinate codes.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encLPNAdvice_length_le (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (L : ℕ) (w : P.LPNAdvice π L) : (P.encLPNAdvice π L w).length ≤ P.lpnAdviceBound.eval L
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every advice word has length at most the explicit polynomial at its independent dimension [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 and Dv15 count hardwired data rather than sampler coins.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpn_hop (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (tails : ℕ → Bool) (hops : ∀ κ, Fin (κ + 1)) : ∃ w : ∀ L, P.LPNAdvice π L, ∀ B : NUPPT, B.RealizesOn (P.lpnEnc π) (A.coins.subst .var) (fun L x r => P.lpnRed π A L (w L) x r) → ∀ κ, (hops κ).val < κ → Games.advantage (P.chainGame A (tails κ) (hops κ).val κ (π κ)) (P.chainGame A (tails κ) ((hops κ).val + 1) κ (π κ)) ≤ (P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv B (P.ℓ κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: One advice family bounds any selected LPN hop for every realizing non-uniform PPT machine [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv8 and Dv12 retain buckets and hardwire averaged values. Dv16 uses the shared, layout-length-only RealizesOn; more realisers are admitted, so this security statement is at least as strong as the every-coin-string draft. The sentinel hop makes advice inhabited at κ=0; the hop inequality is requested only below κ.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev PRGChal (P : Params) (N : ℕ) : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean assumption challenge is an index and a Boolean output vector: `PRGChal N = G.Idx N × (Fin (G.outLen N) → Bool)`. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv4 indexes the Boolean assumption by its own seed length.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgChal_eq (P : Params) (N : ℕ) : P.PRGChal N = (P.G.Idx N × (Fin (P.G.outLen N) → Bool))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean challenge type is the stated index/output pair; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def prgChalCard (P : Params) (N : ℕ) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The explicit Boolean challenge size is `G.idxCard N * 2^(G.outLen N)`; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgChalCard_eq (P : Params) (N : ℕ) : P.prgChalCard N = P.G.idxCard N * 2 ^ P.G.outLen N
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The challenge size is the displayed index/vector product; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def prgChalEquiv (P : Params) (N : ℕ) : P.PRGChal N ≃ Fin (P.prgChalCard N)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean challenge has explicit finite coordinates from the supplied index coordinates and canonical Boolean vector equivalence; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgChalEquiv_eq (P : Params) (N : ℕ) : P.prgChalEquiv N = (Equiv.prodCongr (P.G.idxEquiv N) (ConstructionEncoding.boolVectorEquiv (P.G.outLen N))).trans finProdFinEquiv
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The challenge equivalence is the displayed index/vector/product composition; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def prgEnc (P : Params) (N : ℕ) (x : P.PRGChal N) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The encoded assumption challenge is exactly the Boolean primitive's canonical challenge, `prgEnc N x = G.challengeStr N x.1 x.2`. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. The Boolean assumption has no modulus field; the construction prime is carried in reduction advice.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgEnc_eq (P : Params) (N : ℕ) (x : P.PRGChal N) : P.prgEnc N x = P.G.challengeStr N x.1 x.2
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The assumption encoding is the canonical index/output challenge; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure PRGAdvice (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: PRG-hop advice fixes the bucket map, LPN matrix and all uniform public vectors at `kappa = kappaOfN N`. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 hardwires exactly the values averaged out by the paper's final Boolean PRG hop; Dv9 supplies any prime schedule.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev Data (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice data is the bucket/matrix/uniform-vector product; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem data_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : Data P π N = ((Fin (P.m (P.kappaOfN N)) → Fin (P.B (P.kappaOfN N))) × (Matrix (Fin (P.n (P.kappaOfN N))) (Fin (P.ℓ (P.kappaOfN N))) (ZMod (π (P.kappaOfN N)).p) × (Fin (P.kappaOfN N) → Fin (P.n (P.kappaOfN N)) → ZMod (π (P.kappaOfN N)).p)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice-data type is the displayed product; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def prodEquiv (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : P.PRGAdvice π N ≃ Data P π N
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice record is identified explicitly with its product of fields; glue. The inverse is the record constructor, with both inverse laws given by record reduction.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prodEquiv_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : prodEquiv P π N = { toFun := fun ω => (ω.buckets, ω.matrix, ω.uniform) invFun := fun x => ⟨x.1, x.2.1, x.2.2⟩ left_inv := fun ⟨_, _, _⟩ => rfl right_inv := fun ⟨_, _, _⟩ => rfl }
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The record/product equivalence has the stated projections and constructor; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def prgAdviceCard (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The explicit advice size is `B^m * ((p^ell)^n * (p^n)^kappa)`; glue. Every parameter is read at kappaOfN N and no enumeration is chosen.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgAdviceCard_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : P.prgAdviceCard π N = P.B (P.kappaOfN N) ^ P.m (P.kappaOfN N) * (((π (P.kappaOfN N)).p ^ P.ℓ (P.kappaOfN N)) ^ P.n (P.kappaOfN N) * (((π (P.kappaOfN N)).p ^ P.n (P.kappaOfN N)) ^ P.kappaOfN N))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice size is the displayed bucket/matrix/uniform-vector product; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def prgAdviceEquiv (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : P.PRGAdvice π N ≃ Fin (P.prgAdviceCard π N)
