TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgAdviceEquiv_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : P.prgAdviceEquiv π N = (PRGAdvice.prodEquiv P π N).trans ((Equiv.prodCongr finFunctionFinEquiv ((Equiv.prodCongr (ConstructionEncoding.matrixEquiv (π (P.kappaOfN N)) (P.n (P.kappaOfN N)) (P.ℓ (P.kappaOfN N))) (ConstructionEncoding.matrixEquiv (π (P.kappaOfN N)) (P.kappaOfN N) (P.n (P.kappaOfN N)))).trans finProdFinEquiv)).trans finProdFinEquiv)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice equivalence is the displayed record/function/matrix/product composition; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable instance instPRGAdviceFintype (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : Fintype (P.PRGAdvice π N)
theorem instPRGAdviceFintype_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : instPRGAdviceFintype P π N = Fintype.ofEquiv (Fin (P.prgAdviceCard π N)) (P.prgAdviceEquiv π N).symm
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The PRG advice finiteness instance is induced by its explicit Fin equivalence; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable instance instPRGAdviceInhabited (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : Inhabited (P.PRGAdvice π N)

theorem instPRGAdviceInhabited_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : instPRGAdviceInhabited P π N = { default := { buckets := fun _ => ⟨0, P.B_pos (P.kappaOfN N)⟩ matrix := fun _ _ => 0 uniform := fun _ _ => 0 } }
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The PRG advice default is the explicit zero bucket placement, matrix and vectors; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def encPRGAdvice (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice word starts with the public prime, followed by unary N, bucket placement, the LPN matrix, and the uniform vectors encoded as a kappa-by-n matrix. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv9 publishes the prime as input; Dv12 and Dv15 encode every hardwired value in explicit finite coordinates. The code never computes a prime.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encPRGAdvice_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) : P.encPRGAdvice π N ω = pairEncode (π (P.kappaOfN N)).enc (pairEncode (List.replicate N true) (pairEncode (P.encBuckets (P.kappaOfN N) ω.buckets) (pairEncode (Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix (P.kappaOfN N + 1) ω.matrix) (Encoding.Modular.encodeMatrix (P.kappaOfN N + 1) ω.uniform))))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice code is the stated public-prime-first nested pair; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def prgAdviceDataBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice-data majorant is the sum of the index, seed, output, Boolean-seed, LPN-dimension, and unary-parameter bounds, plus one; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgAdviceDataBound_eq (P : Params) : P.prgAdviceDataBound = .add P.idxBound (.add P.seedBound (.add P.mBound (.add P.nBound (.add P.ellBound (.add .var (.const 1))))))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice-data majorant is its explicit polynomial sum; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def prgAdviceBound (P : Params) : PolyExpr
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The explicit advice bound is `100*(N+1)*(dataBound(N))^3`; glue. The coarse majorant covers every pairing separator, public-prime bit and fixed-width entry.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgAdviceBound_eq (P : Params) : P.prgAdviceBound = .mul (.const 100) (.mul (.add .var (.const 1)) (.pow P.prgAdviceDataBound 3))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The advice bound is the displayed cubic polynomial; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def prgPre (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) (x : P.PRGChal N) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Preprocessing checks the Boolean schedule image, casts the supplied assumption index and output, and publishes the fixed uniform public vectors with error flag false. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv9 and Dv12 read the prime and all fixed data from advice; Dv14 and Dv15 leave machine implementation to its named target. Off-image inputs return an empty word. Neither the generator evaluator nor any sampling operation is called.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgPre_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) (x : P.PRGChal N) : P.prgPre π N ω x = let κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The preprocessing map has the stated schedule guard, explicit transports and layout; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def prgRed (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (N : ℕ) (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) (x : P.PRGChal N) (r : List Bool) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The explicit reduction runs A at kappaOfN N on the deterministic preprocessing and the required coin prefix. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 hardwires the averaged data; Dv14 supplies no machine and assumes no uniform sampling of extra reduction coins.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgRed_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (N : ℕ) (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) (x : P.PRGChal N) (r : List Bool) : P.prgRed π A N ω x r = A.runAtL (P.kappaOfN N) (P.prgPre π N ω x) (r.take (A.coinLen (P.kappaOfN N)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The reduction is exactly runAtL at the inverse parameter with the stated prefix; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def PRGRealizable (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Boolean reduction realisability requires a shared-contract realiser for every adversary and every advice family. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv14 leaves this as a Phase B obligation, linked to preprocessing targets later. Dv16: the shared RealizesOn constrains only encoded challenges and coin strings of layout length; consequently every-realiser security is at least as strong as with the earlier all-coin-strings form. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem PRGRealizable_iff (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : P.PRGRealizable π ↔ ∀ (A : NUPPT) (ω : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N), ∃ B : NUPPT, B.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var) (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ω N) x r)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Boolean realisability is the explicit shared encoded-challenge contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgEnc_injective (P : Params) (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (P.prgEnc N)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The canonical Boolean challenge encoding is injective. [JLS26, Definition 3.4, p. 11; Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv15 retains the complete typed challenge.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encPRGAdvice_injective (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : Function.Injective (P.encPRGAdvice π N)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The explicit PRG-hop advice code retains every fixed bucket, matrix and public vector. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv9, Dv12 and Dv15 retain the prime prefix and all hardwired data.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem encPRGAdvice_length_le (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) : (P.encPRGAdvice π N ω).length ≤ P.prgAdviceBound.eval N
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Every advice encoding fits the explicit syntactic polynomial at N. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 bounds the full hardwired data instead of using fresh sampling; Dv15 accounts for its concrete finite-coordinate string.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem Params.prg_verdict_prob (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (ω : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N) (B : NUPPT) (hB : B.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var) (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ω N) x r)) (N : ℕ) (x : P.PRGChal N) : ProbComp.prob (ProbComp.sample (B.Coins N)) (fun r => B.distinguisherL N (P.prgEnc N x) r = true) = ProbComp.prob (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins (P.kappaOfN N))) (fun r => A.distinguisherL (P.kappaOfN N) (P.prgPre π N (ω N) x) r = true)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A shared-contract PRG realiser has the advised reduction's exact verdict probability; reduction glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Only encoded challenges and layout-length coins are used. The unused suffix is removed by the existing uniform restriction law.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem Params.prg_nuisance_average (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (N : ℕ) : let κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The actual index/seed nuisance draws average to the explicit PRG advice law; construction- specific averaging glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. The Boolean index retains G.idSamp's exact pushforward law; no uniformity of G.Idx is assumed.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem Params.prg_chain_accept_average (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) (N : ℕ) (hN : N = P.n (P.kappaOfN N)) (b : Bool) : accept (P.chainGame A b (P.kappaOfN N) (P.kappaOfN N) (π (P.kappaOfN N))) = ProbComp.expect (ProbComp.sample (P.PRGAdvice π N)) (fun ω => accept ((P.G.idSamp N).bind fun I => (ProbComp.sample (Fin N → Bool)).bind fun σ => (ProbComp.sample (Fin (P.G.outLen N) → Bool)).bind fun v => (ProbComp.sample (A.Coins (P.kappaOfN N))).bind fun r => pure (A.distinguisherL (P.kappaOfN N) (P.prgPre π N ω (I, if b then P.G.eval N I σ else v)) r)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: An all-uniform-public chain is the average of its fixed-advice PRG sections; construction- specific semantic glue for [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. The equality is of acceptance probabilities; unused queries are marginalized only in expectation.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prg_hop (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) : ∃ ω : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N, ∀ B : NUPPT, B.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var) (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ω N) x r) → ∀ κ, Games.advantage (P.chainGame A true κ κ (π κ)) (P.chainGame A false κ κ (π κ)) ≤ P.G.adv B (P.n κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The Boolean PRG hop between all-uniform-public-vector chains is bounded by one Boolean assumption advantage, for every NUPPT realising the explicit advised function. [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv8 retains the bucket map; Dv12 fixes averaged-out data in advice. Dv14 assumes the realiser, and Dv16 uses the shared predicate only on encoded challenges and layout-length coins, strengthening the every-realiser conclusion.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def noiseValue (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (c : Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : ZMod pp.p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: An error coordinate is the residue produced by the canonical LPN scalar core [JLS26, before Definition 2.3, p. 9]. Dv3 uses its exact finite seed; the published seed-type equation transports the explicit draw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem noiseValue_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (c : Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : P.noiseValue κ pp c = ((lpnNoise pp.p (P.W κ)).sample (cast (lpnNoise_coins pp.p (P.W κ)).symm c) : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Noise values read the canonical scalar core through its seed-type reader; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def errSet (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) : Finset (Fin (P.n κ))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: ERR is the set of nonzero error coordinates [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 uses the transposed vector convention.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem errSet_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) : P.errSet κ pp e = Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e i ≠ 0)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: ERR is the nonzero-coordinate filter; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def badSet (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) : Finset (Fin (P.m κ))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: BAD contains outputs whose representation uses an erroneous seed location [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv4 reads locality on the multilinear representation.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem badSet_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) : P.badSet κ pp I e = Finset.univ.filter fun j => ((P.R.poly (P.n κ) I.1 (P.outputIndex κ j)).vars ∩ P.errSet κ pp e).Nonempty
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: BAD is the finite dependency/error-intersection filter; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def oneFlag (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) : Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The one-instance success flag checks all three paper conditions [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 uses rounded integer thresholds and the exact capacity.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem oneFlag_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) : P.oneFlag κ pp I e = decide ((P.badSet κ pp I e).card ≤ P.Γ κ ∧ ¬ (∃ b : Fin (P.B κ), P.cap κ < Buckets.load I.2.1 b) ∧ ∀ b : Fin (P.B κ), (Buckets.bucket I.2.1 b ∩ P.badSet κ pp I e).card ≤ P.t κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Success is the conjunction of bad-count, capacity, and per-bucket bounds; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def corr (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : ZMod pp.p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The correction is the correct Boolean output minus the erroneous polynomial output [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 casts the multilinear integer representation modulo p.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem corr_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (e : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p) (j : Fin (P.m κ)) : P.corr κ pp I σ e j = ((P.G.eval (P.n κ) I.1 σ (P.outputIndex κ j)).toNat : ZMod pp.p) - MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Int.castRingHom (ZMod pp.p)) (fun i => ((σ i).toNat : ZMod pp.p) + e i) (P.R.poly (P.n κ) I.1 (P.outputIndex κ j))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Correction is the stated difference of correct and erroneous outputs; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnVector (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (A : Matrix (Fin (P.n κ)) (Fin (P.ℓ κ)) (ZMod pp.p)) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : Fin (P.n κ) → ZMod pp.p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A public LPN vector is A*s+e+σ [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 uses rows as samples and the canonical scalar-noise core.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnVector_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (A : Matrix (Fin (P.n κ)) (Fin (P.ℓ κ)) (ZMod pp.p)) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : P.lpnVector κ pp A σ s r = fun i => (∑ a, A i a * s a) + P.noiseValue κ pp (r i) + ((σ i).toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The LPN vector is its matrix-vector, error and Boolean-offset formula; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure OneSdOut (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A one-instance seed records its success flag, LPN public vector, and compressed private data [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv15 retains structured private coordinates.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def oneSd (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : P.OneSdOut κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: One-instance sampling is a deterministic core on σ, secret and noise seeds [JLS26, 1SdSamp, p. 16]. Dv3 transposes A; Dv17 uses an exact finite draw; Dv15 uses a deterministic sparse factorization and structured coordinates.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem oneSd_flag (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).flag = P.oneFlag κ pp I (fun i => P.noiseValue κ pp (r i))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The one-instance flag is the three-condition success test; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem oneSd_pub (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).pub = fun i => (∑ a, I.2.2 i a * s a) + P.noiseValue κ pp (r i) + ((σ i).toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The one-instance public vector is A*s+e+σ; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem oneSd_priv (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (σ : Fin (P.n κ) → Bool) (s : Fin (P.ℓ κ) → ZMod pp.p) (r : Fin (P.n κ) → Fin (P.W κ) × ZMod pp.p) : (P.oneSd κ pp I σ s r).priv = let e
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The one-instance private vector consists of tensor entries and the conditional sparse factors; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def firstGood {κ : ℕ} (flags : Fin κ → Bool) : Option (Fin κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The first successful repetition is found in increasing Fin order [JLS26, SdSamp', p. 15]. This deterministic search introduces no advice or choice.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem firstGood_eq {κ : ℕ} (flags : Fin κ → Bool) : firstGood flags = (List.finRange κ).find? flags
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The first successful repetition is the ordered find operation; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def packSeed (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) : P.Seed κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Pack the public blocks and error flag, and private flag/S/flag*S triples [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv15 uses the explicit public/private equivalences; Dv10 precomputes flag*S so the evaluation remains private degree two.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem packSeed_fst (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) : (P.packSeed κ pp instances first).1 = fun i => match (P.pubEquiv κ).symm i with | .inl (k, q) => (instances k).pub q | .inr _ => (first.isNone.toNat : ZMod pp.p)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The packed public vector reads instance blocks and the no-success flag; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem packSeed_snd (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (instances : Fin κ → P.OneSdOut κ pp) (first : Option (Fin κ)) : (P.packSeed κ pp instances first).2 = fun i => match (P.privEquiv κ).symm i with | (k, .inl _) => if first = some k then 1 else 0 | (k, .inr (.inl v)) => (instances k).priv v | (k, .inr (.inr v)) => (if first = some k then 1 else 0) * (instances k).priv v
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The packed private vector is the flag/S/flag*S triple in Fin order; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: structure SdCoreOut (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A full core output retains the original Boolean seed, repetitions, selected index, error flag and packed seed [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. These extra proof-facing fields are not published to the adversary; Dv17 keeps the exact draw visible for coupling.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def sdCore (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : P.SdCoreOut κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: SdSamp's deterministic core runs the κ repetitions and selects their first success [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv17 maps one exact joint draw; no sampler is implemented.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdCore_σ (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : (P.sdCore κ pp I d).σ = d.1
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The original Boolean seed is retained by sdCore; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdCore_draw (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : (P.sdCore κ pp I d).draw = d
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The full exact draw is retained by sdCore for coupling arguments; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdCore_instances (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : (P.sdCore κ pp I d).instances = fun k => P.oneSd κ pp I d.1 (d.2 k).1 (d.2 k).2
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The repetition outputs are exactly the oneSd cores; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdCore_first (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : (P.sdCore κ pp I d).first = firstGood (fun k => (P.oneSd κ pp I d.1 (d.2 k).1 (d.2 k).2).flag)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The selected repetition is the ordered first-success search; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdCore_err (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : (P.sdCore κ pp I d).err = (firstGood (fun k => (P.oneSd κ pp I d.1 (d.2 k).1 (d.2 k).2).flag)).isNone
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The error flag is true exactly when no repetition succeeds; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdCore_seed (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (d : P.Draw κ pp) : (P.sdCore κ pp I d).seed = P.packSeed κ pp (fun k => P.oneSd κ pp I d.1 (d.2 k).1 (d.2 k).2) (firstGood (fun k => (P.oneSd κ pp I d.1 (d.2 k).1 (d.2 k).2).flag))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The core's seed is the explicit packed output; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def idCore (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (d : P.IdDraw κ pp) : P.Idx' κ pp
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: IdSamp's core maps the Boolean generator's draw to I and keeps the other draws [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv17 ties index sampling to its actual uniform joint draw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idCore_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (d : P.IdDraw κ pp) : P.idCore κ pp d = (P.G.idCore (P.n κ) d.1, d.2)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: IdSamp's core maps only its Boolean-generator component; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def idSamp' (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : ProbComp (P.Idx' κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: IdSamp' is the exact law of its one joint uniform draw and core [JLS26, IdSamp', p. 15]. Dv17 postpones fair-coin realization to a target.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idSamp'_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.idSamp' κ pp = P.idCore κ pp <$> ProbComp.sample (P.IdDraw κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index sampler is the pushforward of its explicit joint draw; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def sdSampFull (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : ProbComp (P.SdCoreOut κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The full seed law retains the core's proof-facing outputs [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv17 is an exact uniform pushforward.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdSampFull_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : P.sdSampFull κ pp I = P.sdCore κ pp I <$> ProbComp.sample (P.Draw κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Full seed sampling maps sdCore over the uniform joint draw; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def sdSamp' (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : ProbComp (P.Seed κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: SdSamp' returns the seed projection of the full core law [JLS26, SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv17 preserves the exact joint distribution.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdSamp'_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) : P.sdSamp' κ pp I = (fun x => x.seed) <$> P.sdSampFull κ pp I
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed law is the seed projection of the full law; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def eval' (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (sd : P.Seed κ pp) : Fin (P.m κ) → Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Eval' evaluates G4 and recognizes the field value one [JLS26, Eval', pp. 16-17]. Dv10 follows public degree d on p. 17, rather than the overview's d+1; correctness proves its value is always Boolean on sampled seeds.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem eval'_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (sd : P.Seed κ pp) : P.eval' κ pp I sd = fun j => decide (MvPolynomial.eval (Sum.elim sd.1 sd.2) (P.G4 κ pp I j) = 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Eval' recognizes one in each evaluated G4 coordinate; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def challengeStr (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (pub : Fin (P.pubLen κ) → ZMod pp.p) (z : Fin (P.m κ) → Bool) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The construction challenge publishes pp, index, public seed and Boolean output [JLS26, Definition 3.2, p. 10; Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv9 prepends pp; Dv15 uses the fixed public-vector encoding.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem challengeStr_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (pub : Fin (P.pubLen κ) → ZMod pp.p) (z : Fin (P.m κ) → Bool) : P.challengeStr κ pp I pub z = pairEncode pp.enc (pairEncode (P.encIdx' κ pp I) (pairEncode (Encoding.Modular.encodeVector (κ + 1) pub) (List.ofFn z)))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Construction challenges have the stated nested public layout; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem primeWidthBound (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : pp.p ≤ 2 ^ (PolyExpr.add .var (.const 1)).eval κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A public prime fits the syntactic residue width κ+1; glue for the raw assembly.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def jlsSPRG_raw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : SPRG.Raw
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The JLS construction is a raw algorithm bundle [JLS26, construction, pp. 15-17]. Dv1-Dv3 fix the polynomial schedule, field vectors and rounded exact laws; Dv9 supplies an arbitrary prime schedule; Dv15 uses explicit finite coordinates; Dv17-Dv18 add no sampler or efficiency proof here. SP-W1 uses rational δ throughout. The primitive is assembled only from targets.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : jlsSPRG_raw P π = { modulus κ := (π κ).p modulus_prime κ := (π κ).prime residueBits := .add .var (.const 1) modulus_le_pow κ := Params.primeWidthBound κ (π κ) Idx κ := P.Idx' κ (π κ) idxFintype _κ := inferInstance idxNonempty _κ := inferInstance idxCard κ := P.idxCard κ (π κ) idxEquiv κ := P.idxEquiv κ (π κ) IdDraw κ := P.IdDraw κ (π κ) idDrawFintype _κ := inferInstance idDrawNonempty _κ := inferInstance idDrawCard κ := P.idDrawCard κ (π κ) idDrawEquiv κ := P.idDrawEquiv κ (π κ) idCore κ := P.idCore κ (π κ) encIdDraw κ := P.encIdDraw κ (π κ) encIdDraw_injective κ := P.encIdDraw_injective κ (π κ) encIdx κ := P.encIdx' κ (π κ) encIdx_injective κ := P.encIdx'_injective κ (π κ) idxBits := P.idxBound encIdx_length_le κ := P.encIdx'_length_le κ (π κ) pubLen := P.pubLen privLen := P.privLen outLen := P.m seedBound := P.seedBound outBound := P.mBound pubLen_le := P.pubLen_le_seedBound privLen_le := P.privLen_le_seedBound outLen_le := P.m_le_mBound SdDraw κ _ := P.Draw κ (π κ) sdDrawFintype _κ _ := inferInstance sdDrawNonempty _κ _ := inferInstance sdDrawCard κ _ := P.drawCard κ (π κ) sdDrawEquiv κ _ := P.drawEquiv κ (π κ) sdCore κ I d := (P.sdCore κ (π κ) I d).seed encSdDraw κ _ := P.encDraw κ (π κ) encSdDraw_injective κ _ := P.encDraw_injective κ (π κ) eval κ := P.eval' κ (π κ) }
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction is exactly the displayed record of algorithms, encodings, finite coordinates and proved numeric field obligations; glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_modulus (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).modulus κ = (π κ).p
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction's modulus is the supplied schedule; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction's index type is the concrete JLS triple; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_IdDraw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).IdDraw κ = P.IdDraw κ (π κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction's index draw is the concrete joint draw; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_pubLen (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).pubLen κ = P.pubLen κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction's public length is the explicit packed length; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_privLen (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).privLen κ = P.privLen κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction's private length is the explicit packed length; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_outLen (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).outLen κ = P.m κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction's output length is the Boolean generator's schedule; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_encIdx (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) (I : P.Idx' κ (π κ)) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).encIdx κ I = P.encIdx' κ (π κ) I
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw index encoding is the explicit concrete encoding; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_idCore (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) (d : P.IdDraw κ (π κ)) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).idCore κ d = P.idCore κ (π κ) d
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw index core is the concrete core; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_encIdDraw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) (d : P.IdDraw κ (π κ)) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).encIdDraw κ d = P.encIdDraw κ (π κ) d
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw index-draw encoding is the concrete joint-draw code; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw seed draw is the concrete joint draw, independent of index; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_sdCore (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) (I : P.Idx' κ (π κ)) (d : P.Draw κ (π κ)) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).sdCore κ I d = (P.sdCore κ (π κ) I d).seed
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw seed core returns the concrete packed seed; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_encSdDraw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) (I : P.Idx' κ (π κ)) (d : P.Draw κ (π κ)) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).encSdDraw κ I d = P.encDraw κ (π κ) d
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw seed-draw encoding is the concrete joint-draw code; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_raw_eval (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) (I : P.Idx' κ (π κ)) (sd : P.Seed κ (π κ)) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).eval κ I sd = P.eval' κ (π κ) I sd

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw seed sampler equals SdSamp'; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw challenge's modulus prefix equals the input prime encoding; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def Realizable (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Realisability supplies a NUPPT for each explicit reduction and advice family [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv14 leaves this Phase B obligation as a hypothesis; targets discharge it through the shared preTarget theorem. Dv16: the shared RealizesOn constrains only encoded challenges and layout-length coins, which weakens the predicate and strengthens every-realiser security inequalities.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem realizable_iff (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : P.Realizable π ↔ P.LPNRealizable π ∧ P.PRGRealizable π
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Realisability is the conjunction of the two shared-realiser propositions; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lemma42 (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) : ∃ (ωL : ∀ L, P.LPNAdvice π L) (ωG : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N), ∀ BL BG : NUPPT, BL.RealizesOn (P.lpnEnc π) (A.coins.subst .var) (fun L x r => P.lpnRed π A L (ωL L) x r) → BG.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var) (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ωG N) x r) → ∀ κ, advantage (P.chainGame A true 0 κ (π κ)) (P.chainGame A false κ κ (π κ)) ≤ (κ : ℝ) * (P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv BL (P.ℓ κ) + P.G.adv BG (P.n κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The initial real-tail distribution and final uniform-tail distribution differ by at most κ LPN advantages plus one Boolean PRG advantage [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv8 includes independent buckets; Dv12 hardwires averaging choices; Dv14 states the bound for every realising NUPPT, with no machine construction.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prop41 (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (A : NUPPT) : ∃ (ωL : ∀ L, P.LPNAdvice π L) (ωG : ∀ N, P.PRGAdvice π N), ∀ BL BG : NUPPT, BL.RealizesOn (P.lpnEnc π) (A.coins.subst .var) (fun L x r => P.lpnRed π A L (ωL L) x r) → BG.RealizesOn P.prgEnc (A.coins.subst .var) (fun N x r => P.prgRed π A N (ωG N) x r) → ∀ κ, (jlsSPRG_raw P π).adv A κ ≤ 2 * (κ : ℝ) * (P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv BL (P.ℓ κ) + P.G.adv BG (P.n κ) + 2 * P.errProb κ (π κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw sPRG advantage is at most 2κ LPN advantages, one PRG advantage and twice the exact error probability [JLS26, Proposition 4.1, pp. 18-19]. Dv1 fixes the schedule; Dv9 quantifies every prime schedule; Dv12 hardwires averaging choices; Dv18 uses Raw. Dv16: RealizesOn constrains only encoded challenges and layout-length coins, so its weaker predicate makes this every-realiser inequality stronger.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jls_secure (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (hR : P.Realizable π) (hG : P.G.Secure) (hLPN : (P.lpnFamily_raw π).Assumption) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).Secure
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Under realisability and the two assumptions, the raw construction is secure [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv3 uses the construction's own LPN family; Dv13 uses NUPPT adversaries; Dv14 retains realisability as the Phase B obligation, and Dv18 uses Raw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jls_subexpSmall (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (hR : P.Realizable π) {cL cG : ℝ} (hcL : 0 < cL) (hcG : 0 < cG) (hG : ∀ B : NUPPT, SubexpSmall cG (P.G.adv B)) (hLPN : ∀ B : NUPPT, SubexpSmall cL ((P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv B)) (A : NUPPT) : SubexpSmall (min ((P.E : ℝ) * cL) (min ((P.E : ℝ) * P.D * cG) 1) / 2) ((jlsSPRG_raw P π).adv A)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw advantage has explicit subexponential exponent min(E*cL,min(E*D*cG,1))/2 [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv13 uses the shared SubexpSmall API against NUPPT; Dv14 assumes realisability; Dv18 uses Raw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jls_subexpSecure (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) {cLoc : ℕ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (hR : P.Realizable π) (hG : SubexpHard P.G.adv) (hLPN : SubexpHard (P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv) : SubexpHard (jlsSPRG_raw P π).adv
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Subexponential hardness of both assumptions gives subexponential raw sPRG security [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv13 quantifies a common exponent before every adversary; Dv14 assumes the Phase B realisability obligation; Dv18 uses Raw.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem theorem41 (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) {cLoc : ℕ} {τ : ℝ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (hτ : 1 < τ) (hs : P.G.HasStretch τ) (hE : E0 P.d (P.δ : ℝ) τ ≤ P.E) (hR : P.Realizable π) (hG : P.G.Secure) (hLPN : (P.lpnFamily_raw π).Assumption) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).Secure ∧ (jlsSPRG_raw P π).HasComplexity P.d 2 ∧ (jlsSPRG_raw P π).HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction is secure, has public degree d and private degree two, and polynomial stretch [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv1 fixes a sufficiently large schedule; Dv3 uses its own LPN family; Dv6 uses composite bidegree; Dv9 allows every prime schedule; Dv10 follows p. 17's degree d; Dv14 assumes realisability; Dv18 uses Raw. SP-W1 restricts δ to rational data, coerced to real values in the stretch threshold.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem theorem41_subexp (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) {cLoc : ℕ} {τ : ℝ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (hτ : 1 < τ) (hs : P.G.HasStretch τ) (hE : E0 P.d (P.δ : ℝ) τ ≤ P.E) (hR : P.Realizable π) (hG : SubexpHard P.G.adv) (hLPN : SubexpHard (P.lpnFamily_raw π).adv) : SubexpHard (jlsSPRG_raw P π).adv ∧ (jlsSPRG_raw P π).HasComplexity P.d 2 ∧ (jlsSPRG_raw P π).HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction has the same complexity/stretch and subexponential security [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv13 means advantage against NUPPT, Dv14 assumes realisability, and Dv18 leaves the primitive assembly to the targets.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem exists_sprg_raw {d cLoc : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) {δ : ℚ} {τ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hτ : 1 < τ) (G : BoolPRG) (R : G.MultilinearRep d) (hLoc : R.HasLocality cLoc) (hs : G.HasStretch τ) (hG : G.Secure) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hLPN : ∀ (E : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E), (Params.lpnFamily_raw ⟨d, hd, δ, hδ, hδ1, E, hE, G, R⟩ π).Assumption) (hR : ∀ (E : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E), (Params.Realizable ⟨d, hd, δ, hδ, hδ1, E, hE, G, R⟩ π)) : ∃ S : SPRG.Raw, (∀ κ, S.modulus κ = (π κ).p) ∧ S.Secure ∧ S.HasComplexity d 2 ∧ S.HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A secure raw structured-seed generator exists for every prime schedule [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv1 chooses a polynomial schedule; Dv3 assumes LPN only for the construction's own families; Dv14 assumes realisability; Dv18 returns Raw. SP-W1 uses rational δ; this statement does not claim a literal Definition 2.3 bridge.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem exists_sprg_raw_subexp {d cLoc : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) {δ : ℚ} {τ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hτ : 1 < τ) (G : BoolPRG) (R : G.MultilinearRep d) (hLoc : R.HasLocality cLoc) (hs : G.HasStretch τ) (hG : SubexpHard G.adv) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hLPN : ∀ (E : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E), SubexpHard (Params.lpnFamily_raw ⟨d, hd, δ, hδ, hδ1, E, hE, G, R⟩ π).adv) (hR : ∀ (E : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E), (Params.Realizable ⟨d, hd, δ, hδ, hδ1, E, hE, G, R⟩ π)) : ∃ S : SPRG.Raw, (∀ κ, S.modulus κ = (π κ).p) ∧ SubexpHard S.adv ∧ S.HasComplexity d 2 ∧ S.HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A subexponentially secure raw generator exists for every prime schedule [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv13 uses a common subexponential advantage exponent; Dv14 assumes realisability; Dv18 returns the raw bundle. SP-W1 uses rational δ.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def sparseEntries (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) : List (Fin rows × Fin cols)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Nonzero positions are listed in row-major order, `sparseEntries M = [(i,j) in Fin rows × Fin cols | M i j ≠ 0]` [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. The order fixes the paper's unspecified factors; `List.finRange` avoids a choice-based finite enumeration.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseEntries_eq (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) : sparseEntries M = ((List.finRange rows).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange cols).map (fun j => (i, j)))).filter (fun c => decide (M c.1 c.2 ≠ 0))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Sparse positions are the row-major list filtered by nonzero entries. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def sparseLeft (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin t) R
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The left factor puts the `k`th nonzero entry in its row in column `k`, with zero for missing slots [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. The row-major order makes the paper's factor choice deterministic.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseLeft_eq (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : sparseLeft M t = fun i k => match (sparseEntries M)[k.val]? with | none => 0 | some c => if i = c.1 then M c.1 c.2 else 0
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The left factor reads a nonzero position by its slot and writes its entry value. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def sparseRight (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin t) (Fin cols) R
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The right factor puts one at the column of the `k`th nonzero entry in row `k`, with zero for missing slots [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. The row-major order makes the paper's factor choice deterministic.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseRight_eq (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : sparseRight M t = fun k j => match (sparseEntries M)[k.val]? with | none => 0 | some c => if j = c.2 then 1 else 0
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The right factor reads a nonzero position by its slot and selects its column. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def sparseFactor (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin t) R × Matrix (Fin t) (Fin cols) R
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Sparse factors are the deterministic pair `(sparseLeft M t, sparseRight M t)` [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. No existence witness or rank decomposition is selected; the raw functions are defined even when the sparsity bound fails.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseFactor_eq (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : sparseFactor M t = (sparseLeft M t, sparseRight M t)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The sparse-factor pair consists of its explicit left and right factors. Glue reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseFactor_fst (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : (sparseFactor M t).1 = sparseLeft M t
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The first sparse factor is the explicit left matrix. Glue projection reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseFactor_snd (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) : (sparseFactor M t).2 = sparseRight M t
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The second sparse factor is the explicit right matrix. Glue projection reader.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseEntries_nodup (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) : (sparseEntries M).Nodup
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Nonzero positions occur exactly once in the sparse list [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. This is mathematical glue for the chosen factors.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem mem_sparseEntries_iff (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (c : Fin rows × Fin cols) : c ∈ sparseEntries M ↔ M c.1 c.2 ≠ 0
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A position belongs to the sparse list exactly when its entry is nonzero [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. This is mathematical glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseEntries_length_eq_card (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) : (sparseEntries M).length = (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : Fin rows × Fin cols => M c.1 c.2 ≠ 0)).card
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The sparse list's length equals the number of nonzero matrix positions [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. This is mathematical glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseFactor_mul (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) (h : (sparseEntries M).length ≤ t) : (sparseFactor M t).1 * (sparseFactor M t).2 = M
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: At most `t` nonzero entries suffice for the explicit factors to multiply to the matrix, `(sparseFactor M t).1 * (sparseFactor M t).2 = M` [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. This constructive factorization replaces the paper's rank-existence justification without changing its factors' dimensions.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sparseFactor_mul_of_card_le (M : Matrix (Fin rows) (Fin cols) R) (t : ℕ) (h : (Finset.univ.filter (fun c : Fin rows × Fin cols => M c.1 c.2 ≠ 0)).card ≤ t) : (sparseFactor M t).1 * (sparseFactor M t).2 = M
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A finite cardinal bound on nonzero entries implies reconstruction by the sparse factors [JLS26, sampling algorithm 1SdSamp, p. 16]. This is mathematical glue for bucket matrices.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def E0 (_d : ℕ) (δ τ : ℝ) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A sufficient schedule exponent is `E0 d delta tau = floor(max(10/delta,5/(tau-1)))+1`. [JLS26, Claim 4.1, p. 18]. Dv1 makes sufficiently large polynomial seed length an explicit condition on E. Convention C10 uses a deliberately generous fifth-power seed bound; d is retained in the interface although this sufficient threshold is independent of it when d≥1. SP-W1 coerces the construction's rational delta to real.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem E0_eq (d : ℕ) (δ τ : ℝ) : E0 d δ τ = ⌊max (10 / δ) (5 / (τ - 1))⌋₊ + 1
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The sufficient exponent is its stated real-power comparison threshold; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def seedBitsAt (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : ℕ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The construction's seed payload has `seedBitsAt kappa = (pubLen kappa + privLen kappa)*(kappa+1)` bits. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.1, p. 18]. Dv2 uses fixed-width field vectors. Dv9's arbitrary public prime changes no width, so this count is uniform in that prime.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem seedBitsAt_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.seedBitsAt κ = (P.pubLen κ + P.privLen κ) * (κ + 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The payload count is the total coordinate count times kappa+1; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem seedBitsAt_le (P : Params) : ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ κ, P.seedBitsAt κ ≤ C * (κ + 1) ^ 5 * (P.n κ + P.m κ / P.w κ + 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed payload is at most `C*(kappa+1)^5*(n+m/w+1)` for a fixed natural C, uniformly over every kappa and every public prime. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.1, p. 18]. Dv1 fixes the polynomial schedule; Dv2-Dv3 replace the asymptotic expression by this explicit integral upper bound. Natural division and the final one cover rounding and the zero-parameter boundary. SP-W1 uses rational delta.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem w_lower (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) : (κ : ℝ) ^ ((P.E : ℝ) * ((P.δ : ℝ) / 2)) / 2 ≤ (P.w κ : ℝ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: At every κ≥1, rounded noise width is at least half of κ^(E*δ/2). [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.1, p. 18]. This is glue for the integral noise schedule.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem stretch_gaps (P : Params) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 1 < τ) (hE : E0 P.d (P.δ : ℝ) τ ≤ P.E) : 0 < (((P.E * P.D : ℕ) : ℝ) * (τ - 1) - 5) ∧ 0 < (P.E : ℝ) * ((P.δ : ℝ) / 2) - 5
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The sufficient E0 threshold leaves positive exponent gaps for public and noise terms. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.1, p. 18]. The integral threshold makes both gaps strict.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem eventually_seed_relative_gap (P : Params) {τ ε : ℝ} (hs : P.G.HasStretch τ) (hε : 0 < ε) (hpublic : 5 + ((P.E * P.D : ℕ) : ℝ) + 2 * ε ≤ ((P.E * P.D : ℕ) : ℝ) * τ) (hnoise : 5 - (P.E : ℝ) * ((P.δ : ℝ) / 2) ≤ -2 * ε) : ∀ᶠ κ : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (P.seedBitsAt κ : ℝ) ≤ (P.m κ : ℝ) * (κ : ℝ) ^ (-ε)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Positive public/noise exponent gaps give seedBitsAt ≤ m*κ^(-ε) eventually. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.1, p. 18]. This quantitative glue keeps the rounded width and the fixed payload coefficient explicit, uniformly over public prime schedules.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jls_seedBits_eq (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (κ : ℕ) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).seedBits κ = P.seedBitsAt κ
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction's seed-bit function equals the prime-independent payload count. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.1, p. 18]. Dv1-Dv2 and Dv9 fix the family and residue width.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jls_seedBits_le (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) : ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ κ, (jlsSPRG_raw P π).seedBits κ ≤ C * (κ + 1) ^ 5 * (P.n κ + P.m κ / P.w κ + 1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction has seed length at most `C*(kappa+1)^5*(n+m/w+1)` at every parameter. [JLS26, proof of Claim 4.1, p. 18]. Dv1-Dv3 make the schedule, field widths and exact rounding explicit; the constant can be chosen independently of the public prime schedule.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jls_hasPolyStretch (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 1 < τ) (hs : P.G.HasStretch τ) (hE : E0 P.d (P.δ : ℝ) τ ≤ P.E) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The raw construction has polynomial stretch when its schedule exponent is at least E0. [JLS26, Claim 4.1, p. 18]. Dv1 replaces sufficiently large polynomial seed length by `E0 d delta tau ≤ E`; Dv3 uses rounded noise and Dv5 uses the input stretch lower bound. SP-W1 supplies rational delta, coerced to real for the threshold. Dv18 keeps this stretch theorem on the raw bundle; honest efficiency is supplied by the later assembly. SP-W3 requires eventual seed growth as well as the power bound.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: abbrev SdParam (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : Type
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: A seed-sampler input consists of its public prime and function index [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv9 and Dv17 expose these as the shared contract's parameter rather than asking an algorithm to compute the prime.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdParam_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) : P.SdParam κ = (Σ pp : PrimeParam κ, P.Idx' κ pp)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed-sampler parameter is its prime/index dependent pair; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def idWord (_P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index-sampler parameter word starts with pp and includes unary κ [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv9 and Dv17 keep public inputs explicit.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idWord_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (pp : PrimeParam κ) : P.idWord κ pp = pairEncode pp.enc (List.replicate κ true)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The index word is pp paired with unary κ; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def sdWord (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (q : P.SdParam κ) : List Bool
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed-sampler word starts with pp, then unary κ and index [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10]. Dv17 indexes one exact joint draw by this public word.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdWord_eq (P : Params) (κ : ℕ) (q : P.SdParam κ) : P.sdWord κ q = pairEncode q.1.enc (pairEncode (List.replicate κ true) (P.encIdx' κ q.1 q.2))
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The seed word carries pp, unary κ and the concrete index code; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def evalTarget (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T1 requires one uniform map for Eval' on every κ and input prime [JLS26, Definition 3.1, p. 10; Eval', pp. 16-17]. Dv9 and Dv18 defer efficiency. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem evalTarget_iff (P : Params) : P.evalTarget ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ κ (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (sd : P.Seed κ pp), f (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode pp.enc (pairEncode (P.encIdx' κ pp I) (P.encSeed' κ pp sd)))) = List.ofFn (P.eval' κ pp I sd)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def qGenTarget (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T2 requires uniform generation of a term list denoting each G4 output polynomial [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10; Equation (4), p. 17]. Dv6 uses composite polynomials, Dv15 uses explicit Fin coordinates, and Dv18 defers generation efficiency. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem qGenTarget_iff (P : Params) : P.qGenTarget ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ κ (pp : PrimeParam κ) (I : P.Idx' κ pp) (j : Fin (P.m κ)), ∃ ts : PolyTerms (Fin (P.pubLen κ) ⊕ Fin (P.privLen κ)) (ZMod pp.p), f (NUPPT.advInput κ (pairEncode pp.enc (pairEncode (P.encIdx' κ pp I) (PolyTerms.encFin j)))) = PolyTerms.encTerms (fun z => Candidates.natToList (κ + 1) z.val) (fun v => PolyTerms.encFin (finSumFinEquiv v)) ts ∧ PolyTerms.denote ts = P.G4 κ pp I j
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def coreTarget (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T3 requires uniform computability of the actual index and seed cores [JLS26, IdSamp' and SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv17-Dv18 use the shared CoreComputable halves on the same joint draws as T5, without constructing any sampler. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem coreTarget_iff (P : Params) : P.coreTarget ↔ CoreComputable (P := PrimeParam) (fun κ pp => P.idWord κ pp) (fun κ pp => P.encIdDraw κ pp) (fun κ pp => P.encIdx' κ pp) (fun κ pp => P.idCore κ pp) ∧ CoreComputable (P := P.SdParam) (fun κ q => P.sdWord κ q) (fun κ q => P.encDraw κ q.1) (fun κ q => P.encSeed' κ q.1) (fun κ q d => (P.sdCore κ q.1 q.2 d).seed)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def lpnPreTarget (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T4 requires one uniform preprocessing map for every LPN schedule and advice [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 puts all averaging choices and pp in the advice input; Dv14 defers efficiency and never samples inside the reduction. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnPreTarget_iff (P : Params) : P.lpnPreTarget ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ (π : PrimeSchedule) L (ω : P.LPNAdvice π L) (x : P.LPNChal π L), f (pairEncode (P.encLPNAdvice π L ω) (P.lpnEnc π L x)) = P.lpnPre π L ω x
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def prgPreTarget (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T4 requires one uniform preprocessing map for every PRG schedule and advice [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv12 carries pp and the averaging choices on the advice input; Dv14 defers efficiency and constructs no machine. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem prgPreTarget_iff (P : Params) : P.prgPreTarget ↔ ∃ f : List Bool → List Bool, PolyTimeComputable f ∧ ∀ (π : PrimeSchedule) N (ω : P.PRGAdvice π N) (x : P.PRGChal N), f (pairEncode (P.encPRGAdvice π N ω) (P.prgEnc N x)) = P.prgPre π N ω x
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def ReductionTargets (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The reduction targets are the two uniform preprocessing obligations [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv14 separates these from the security inequality. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem reductionTargets_iff (P : Params) : P.ReductionTargets ↔ P.lpnPreTarget ∧ P.prgPreTarget
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def drawSamplerTarget (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T5 requires fair-coin samplability of each complete exact draw [JLS26, IdSamp' and SdSamp', pp. 15-16]. Dv17-Dv18 use the shared DrawSamplable halves. Each target concerns one draw type, even when that type is a product. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem drawSamplerTarget_iff (P : Params) : P.drawSamplerTarget ↔ DrawSamplable (P := PrimeParam) (fun κ pp => P.idWord κ pp) (fun κ pp => P.encIdDraw κ pp) ∧ DrawSamplable (P := P.SdParam) (fun κ q => P.sdWord κ q) (fun κ q => P.encDraw κ q.1)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def lpnSamplerTarget (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T6 requires uniform efficient sampling of the construction's joint LPN draw and core [JLS26, Definition 2.3, pp. 9-10]. Dv3 uses its own rounded family; Dv9 passes the prime on the parameter word. The sampler and map are quantified before the schedule, which is the shared contract's parameter, and do not compute it. Dv17-Dv18 keep the exact law. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnSamplerTarget_iff (P : Params) : P.lpnSamplerTarget ↔ SamplesEfficiently (P := fun _ => PrimeSchedule) (fun L π => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).sampleWord L) (fun L π => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).encDraw L) (fun L π => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).encSample L) (fun L π => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).sampleCore L)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: def Targets (P : Params) : Prop
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The six efficiency obligations jointly inhabit the raw construction as a primitive [JLS26, Definitions 3.1-3.3, p. 10; construction, pp. 15-17]. Dv18 keeps all efficiency proofs in these targets, while every inhabited primitive carries their consequences. Phase B obligation; not proved in this development.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem targets_iff (P : Params) : P.Targets ↔ P.evalTarget ∧ P.qGenTarget ∧ P.coreTarget ∧ P.ReductionTargets ∧ P.drawSamplerTarget ∧ P.lpnSamplerTarget
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The target is its stated uniform contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem realizable_of_targets (P : Params) (hT : P.ReductionTargets) : ∀ π : PrimeSchedule, P.Realizable π
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The preprocessing targets give realisers for every schedule and advice family [JLS26, Lemma 4.2, p. 19]. Dv14 discharges realisability from target hypotheses; Dv16 uses the shared layout-coin RealizesOn predicate and its public link theorem.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem evalEfficient_of_target (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hT : P.evalTarget) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).EvalEfficient
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T1 gives the raw evaluator's uniform efficiency; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem idSampEfficient_of_targets (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hC : P.coreTarget) (hD : P.drawSamplerTarget) : SamplesEfficiently (P := fun _ => Unit) (fun κ _ => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).idWord κ) (fun κ _ => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).encIdDraw κ) (fun κ _ => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).encIdx κ) (fun κ _ => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).idCore κ)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T3 and T5 give the exact index sampler's efficiency through the shared contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem sdSampEfficient_of_targets (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hC : P.coreTarget) (hD : P.drawSamplerTarget) : SamplesEfficiently (P := (jlsSPRG_raw P π).Idx) (fun κ I => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).sdWord κ I) (fun κ I => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).encSdDraw κ I) (fun κ _ => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).encSeed κ) (fun κ I => (jlsSPRG_raw P π).sdCore κ I)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T3 and T5 give the exact seed sampler's efficiency through the shared contract; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnSamplerEfficient_of_target (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hT : P.lpnSamplerTarget) : SamplesEfficiently (P := fun _ => Unit) (fun L _ => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).sampleWord L) (fun L _ => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).encDraw L) (fun L _ => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).encSample L) (fun L _ => (P.lpnFamily_raw π).sampleCore L)
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T6 specializes to the sampler field of each raw LPN family; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def lpnFamily (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hT : P.Targets) : LPNFamily
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The construction's LPN primitive is assembled from its raw family and T6 [JLS26, Definition 2.3, pp. 9-10]. Dv18 requires this efficiency witness for any instance.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem lpnFamily_toRaw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hT : P.Targets) : (P.lpnFamily π hT).toRaw = P.lpnFamily_raw π
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The assembled LPN primitive has exactly the specified raw family; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem hasComplexityEff_of_target (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hT : P.qGenTarget) : (jlsSPRG_raw P π).HasComplexityEff P.d 2
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: T2 generates the bidegree-bounded G4 output polynomials [JLS26, Definition 3.3, p. 10; Equation (4), p. 17]. Dv6 uses the composite form.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: noncomputable def jlsSPRG (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hT : P.Targets) : SPRG
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The efficient JLS sPRG is assembled from the raw algorithms and targets [JLS26, construction, pp. 15-17]. Dv18 makes efficiency mandatory: no primitive value is supplied without its evaluator and two sampler witnesses.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem jlsSPRG_toRaw (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hT : P.Targets) : (jlsSPRG P π hT).toRaw = jlsSPRG_raw P π
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The assembled primitive's raw bundle is exactly jlsSPRG_raw; glue.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem theorem41_of_targets (P : Params) (π : PrimeSchedule) {cLoc : ℕ} {τ : ℝ} (hLoc : P.R.HasLocality cLoc) (hτ : 1 < τ) (hs : P.G.HasStretch τ) (hE : E0 P.d (P.δ : ℝ) τ ≤ P.E) (hT : P.Targets) (hG : P.G.Secure) (hLPN : (P.lpnFamily_raw π).Assumption) : (jlsSPRG P π hT).Secure ∧ (jlsSPRG P π hT).HasComplexityEff P.d 2 ∧ (jlsSPRG P π hT).HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: The targets give a secure primitive with efficient (d,2) complexity and stretch [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv3 assumes the construction's own LPN family; Dv6 uses composite bidegree; Dv9 allows every prime schedule; Dv18 assembles efficiency. SP-W1 uses rational δ, coerced to real values in the schedule threshold.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem exists_sprg_of_targets {d cLoc : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) {δ : ℚ} {τ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hτ : 1 < τ) (G : BoolPRG) (R : G.MultilinearRep d) (hLoc : R.HasLocality cLoc) (hs : G.HasStretch τ) (hG : G.Secure) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hLPN : ∀ (E : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E), (Params.lpnFamily_raw ⟨d, hd, δ, hδ, hδ1, E, hE, G, R⟩ π).Assumption) (hT : ∀ P : Params, P.Targets) : ∃ S : SPRG, (∀ κ, S.modulus κ = (π κ).p) ∧ S.Secure ∧ S.HasComplexityEff d 2 ∧ S.HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Under the efficiency targets an efficient secure sPRG exists [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv3 uses the construction's own LPN families; Dv18 inhabits the primitive from targets rather than asserting unproved efficiency. SP-W1 restricts δ to rational data.

TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.normalized_header: theorem exists_sprg_of_targets_subexp {d cLoc : ℕ} (hd : 1 ≤ d) {δ : ℚ} {τ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (hτ : 1 < τ) (G : BoolPRG) (R : G.MultilinearRep d) (hLoc : R.HasLocality cLoc) (hs : G.HasStretch τ) (hG : SubexpHard G.adv) (π : PrimeSchedule) (hLPN : ∀ (E : ℕ) (hE : 1 ≤ E), SubexpHard (Params.lpnFamily_raw ⟨d, hd, δ, hδ, hδ1, E, hE, G, R⟩ π).adv) (hT : ∀ P : Params, P.Targets) : ∃ S : SPRG, (∀ κ, S.modulus κ = (π κ).p) ∧ SubexpHard S.adv ∧ S.HasComplexityEff d 2 ∧ S.HasPolyStretch
TCSlib.Cryptography.Obfuscation.Structur.statement_prose_prefix: Under the targets and subexponential assumptions an efficient subexponentially secure sPRG exists [JLS26, Theorem 4.1, p. 11]. Dv13 bounds advantage against NUPPT; Dv18 requires the honest efficiency fields. SP-W1 uses rational δ.
